tei:div.tei:p: (ka)༄༅// paṇ+ḍi ta chen po sa man+ta shrī nas brgyud pa'i dbyangs can ma dkar mo'i sgrub thabs rjes gnang dang bcas pa'i skor rnams bzhugs so// ༄༅// lha mo dbyangs can ma la phyag 'tshal lo// sgra dbyangs lha mo'i rjes gnang byed par 'dod pas/ gnas dben zhing nyams dga' bar rin po che'am/ shing ngam/ rdo la sogs pa gzhi khod snyoms par chu gtsang mas dag par bkru/ brlan ma yal bar dri bzang gi phye ma bkram/ de'i steng du gser gyi thur mas pad+ma 'dab ma brgyad pa/ lte ba la zla ba'i dkyil 'khor/ de'i dbus su hrīṃḥ 'dab ma rnams la mdun nas g.yas skor du/ a ā/ i ī/ u ū/ ṛ ṝ/ l̥ l̥̄/ e ai/ o au/ aṃ aḥ zhes pa rnams bris la/ 'bras dkar po bzang gtsang gis ri mo'i steng nas mnan/ zan gtsang ma'i ting lo bcu bdun/ ba dmar ser gyi mar dang*/ sbrang rtsi sbyar bas bkang ba sdong bu dang bcas pa byas la/ yi ge re re'i mdun du dgod/ chu bzhi dang bcas pa'i nyer spyod kyis bskor/ de nas slob dpon rang nyid khrus bya/ gdong dri zhim pos byug kha dri zhim par bya/ gos dkar po dri ma med pa bgo zhing*/ stan dkar po gtsang ma la bde bar 'dug ste/ bdag bskyed bzlas pa dang bcas pa rdzogs pa'i mthar/ mdun gyi 'khor lo mi dmigs pa las/ 'og nas 'byung ba bzhin/ lha mo thugs kyi 'khor lo dang bcas pa gsal bar bsgom/ de nas rang gi thugs kyi ngo bo hrīṃḥlas 'od zer dkar po sna bug g.yas pa nas dbugs dang lhan cig phyir 'phros/ dbyangs can ma ye shes pa 'khor dang bcas pa spyan drangs/ mdun bskyed dang gnyis su med par bstim/ swa ra swa sti tiṣ+ṭha hrīṃḥ a ā nas/ aḥ'i bar brjod pas brtan par byas la/ chu bzhi sngon du 'gro ba'i nyer spyod kyis mchod/ bstod pas bstod/ a kā ros gtor ma bsngos la/ slob ma'i snying la 'bab par mdzad du gsol/ ma rig pa'i mun pa bsal du gsol/ ye shes kyi snang ba bskyed du gsol/

nyon mongs pa'i drwa ba bcad du gsol/ ma rig pa'i ling tog bsal du gsol/ bdag med rtogs pa'i shes rab khyad par can bskyed du gsol/ zhes gsol ba btab pa'i rjes la/ oṃ āḥswa ra swa sti me tiṣ+ṭha ku ru hūm̐/ zhes brjod pas/ mdun gyi lha mo rang la thim pas gnyis su med par bsgom/ de nas slob ma rnams lus ril por khrus lan gsum bya/ rlan ma bral ba la dri bzang gi phye mas lus thams cad byugs/ kha dri zhim pos bgo/ dar ram ras dkar po'i gos gtsang ma sngar longs ma spyad pa gon/ ras dkar po gtsang ma'i gdan gyi steng du/ 'bras dkar po'i 'dab brgyad zla ba'i dkyil 'khor dang bcas pa bri/ de'i steng du ku sha gsar pa rtse mo nang du bstan pa bkram/ de'i steng du tsog bu'i tshul gyis 'dug tu gzhug phyag dang yon phul la/ sgra dbyangs lha mo'i rjes gnang stsal du gsol/ zhes tshig gang yang rung bas gsol ba gdab/ de nas slob dpon gyis dmigs pa dpod bsgom du byas la/ lus lha mo dbyangs can ma/ sku mdog dkar mo/ shel dkar po dri ma med pa ltar phyi bltas nang gsal ba/ nang bltas phyi gsal ba/ 'od zer dkar po 'phro ba dang bcas pa/ pad+ma dkar po 'dab ma stong dang ldan pa'i lte ba'i steng du/ zla ba'i dkyil 'khor dri ma med pa'i steng du/ tsog pu'i tshul du bzhugs pa/ dbu skra 'jam zhing mnyen pa bung ba ltar gnag pa/ thor cog cung zad dang bcas pa la me tog dkar po'i phreng ba bcings pa/ lhag ma rnams rgyab tu 'phyangs ba la rin po che sna tshogs pa'i rgyan gyis spras pa/ gser gyi rna cha la rin po che sna tshogs pa'i phra bkod pas mkhur tshos mdzes par brgyan pa/ dbu rgyan/ mgul rgyan/ snyan rgyan/ do shal/ phyag gdub/ zhabs gdub rnams rin po che sna tshogs pas khra chabs se/ khrol le/ sil khrol gyi sgra snyan par sgrogs pa/ gzhon nu ma lo bcu drug lon pa'i rnam pa can/ lang tsho dar la babs pa/

reg na bde ba skyed pa'i nu ma gnyis mkhregs shing rgyas pa/ chags pa'i nyams dang ldan pas g.yon du 'gying zhing*/ spyan zur mig gis gzigs pa/ ka tsa li kā'i stod g.yogs dang*/ smad g.yogs me tog tshom bus spras pa/ pad+ma dkar po'i chun 'phyang gis mdzes par brgyan zhing phyag gnyis kyis bai ḍūr sngon po'i pi waṃ rgyud stong dang ldan pa sgreng bas/ lha dang*/ dri za dang*/ rig pa 'dzin pa la sogs pa skye 'phags thams cad kyi yid 'phrog par mdzad pa/ spyi gtsug zla ba'i dkyil 'khor dri ma med pas brgyan par bsgom du gzhug go /de'i snying mgo mthur bstan du yod pa/ blos gyen du bslangs te/ tshal ba brgyad phyir gyes pa/ pad+ma dkar po 'dab ma brgyad pa dkar zhing 'jam pa/ ze'u 'bru dmar ser gyis bskor ba'i mtshams nas/ nyi ma stong dang mnyam pa'i 'od zer 'phro ba/ lte ba'i steng na zla ba'i dkyil 'khor nya gang ba dri ma med pa'i dbus su/ sems kyi ngo bo yi ge hrīṃḥdakar po ring cha zla tshes thig le nā da dang bcas pa/ 'dab ma rnams la mdun nas brtsams te/ g.yas skor du dbyangs yig bcu drug 'dab ma re re la yi ge gnyis gnyis gnas pa thams cad kyang shel dkar po dri ma med pa ltar dwangs shing gsal ba/ ldem mo bzhengs nas/ gdan la ma reg tsam cung zad 'dar zhing*/ 'khor lo yi ge dang bcas pa'i 'od zer gyi drwa bas snying gi mun pa ma lus pa sel bar bsgom/ de nas slob dpon gyi lag pa g.yas pa'i mthe bos mthe'u chung mnan/ sor mo lhag ma gsum bsgreng ba rdo rje rtse gsum pa'i phyag rgya bcas la/ slob ma'i stan la reg nas/ oṃ ā dha ra shak+ti ka ma la ā sa na dā na daḥ zhes pas stan byin gyis brlab/ de'i rjes la slob mas sngags 'di rnams kyi rjes su bzlas te/ oṃ aṅguṣ+ṭhā ya na maḥ oṃ tardza n+yai na maḥ oṃ mā dh+ya mā ye na maḥ oṃ a nā mi kā ye na maḥ oṃ ka niṣ+ṭhi kā ye na maḥ

oṃ kār+ya ka bṛṣ+ṭi bh+yo na maḥ oṃ swa ra swa sti me tiṣ+ṭha ku ru hūm̐/ lha mo dbyangs can ma bdag la brtan par mdzod cig ces gsol ba btab pas/ slob dpon dang dbyer mi phyed par gyur pa'i lha mo las/ lha mo gnyis pa mar me gcig las gnyis chad kyi tshul du byung nas mtsho la kha ba babs pa ltar rang la gnyis su med par thim pas lha mo'i sku dang rang gi lus dbyer mi phyed par bsgom/ slob dpon gyis slob ma'i spyi bor me tog dkar po bzhag la/ lha mo 'di la stsal lags kyi// lha mo 'di la byin gyis rlobs// zhes dang*/ slob mas/ lha mo bdag la stsal lags kyi// bdag la 'go bar mdzad du gsol// zhes brjod do// de nas slob dpon gyis/ sngar gyi rdo rje rtse gsum pa'i phyag rgya slob ma'i snying gar reg la/ oṃ hṛ da yā ya tiṣ+ṭha/ dpral bar reg la/ oṃ shi ra si swā hā/ spyi bor reg la/ oṃ shi khā yai bauṣaṭa/ nam tshos su reg la/ oṃ ka ba tsā ye hūm̐/ mig gnyis su reg la/ oṃ ni tra yā ya boṣaṭa/ lag pa gnyis la reg la/ oṃ hastā ya phaṭa/ ces pas brtan par byin gyis brlabs par bsgoms te/ sku'i rjes gnang ngo*// de nas slob dpon dang lha mo gnyis su med pa'i 'khor lo las hrīṃḥgi phreng ba zhal nas byung ste/ de las 'od zer dkar po phyogs bcur 'phros/ 'jig rten gyi khams na yod pa'i sangs rgyas dang byang chub sems dpa'/ 'phags pa nyan thos dang*/ rang sangs rgyas/ grub pa thob pa'i rnal 'byor pa dang*/ mkhas pa paṇ+ḍi ta/ rig pa 'dzin pa/ smon lam la dbang ba'i drang srong dang*/ rgyal po dang*/ bu mo gzhon nu ma la sogs pa dang*/ rin po che'i rigs dang*/ sman dang*/ rtsi bcud la sogs pa thams cad kyi shes rab dang*/ brtse ba dang*/ mthu dang*/ nus pa dang*/ gzi brjid la sogs pa yon tan gyi tshogs thams cad kyi nus pa rnams rdo khab len gyis lcags bsdus pa ltar bsdus/ rang gi kha nas zhugs/

'khor lo yig 'bru dang bcas pa la thim pas shes bya thams cad la blo gros thogs pa med par rgyas shing mthu nus gzi brjid dang ldan par bsgom zhing*/ dpon slob gnyis kas phreng ba bzung la/ hrīṃḥbargya rtsa brgyad dang*/ hrīṃḥdabyangs yig dang bcas pa bdun nam nyer gcig bzla/ de nas phreng ba de slob ma'i mgo la bskon la/ oṃ hrīṃḥb ra wā ka wā dī na maḥ zhes rjes su bzla ste/ gsung gi rjes gnang ngo*// de nas sngar gyi sdong bu rnams spar la/ slob dpon dang lha mo gnyis su med pa'i thugs ka'i yi ge las/ yi ge rang 'dra'i rnam pa rin po che'i sgron me bstar la brgyus pa lta bu byung*/ de dag las 'od zer 'phros pas/ sngar gyi dmigs pa dang ldan pas/ slob ma rang gi 'khor lo yig 'bru dang bcas pa la thim pas/ lha mo'i thugs dang rang gi sems dbyer med du gyur pas/ phyi nang gi mun pa rnams bsal/ shes bya thams cad la blo gros thogs pa med par rgyas par bsgom zhing*/ mar me rnams yi ge'i ngo bor bsgoms la/ hrīṃḥdabyangs yig dang bcas pa tshang bar brjod cing*/ the tshom med par zar gzhug go /de nyid brtan par bya ba'i phyir/ oṃ swa ra swa sti me hṛ da yo tiṣ+ṭha hrīṃḥ.a ā nas aḥ'i bar rjes su bzla ste/ thugs kyi rjes gnang ngo*// de nas slob mas phyag dang yon phul la bka' drin che'o zhes brjod cing*/ las kyi rjes mi mngon par bsdu/ dge ba'i rtsa ba sems can thams cad kyis shes rab khyad par can thob pa'i rgyur bsngo'o// rjes su gnang ba'i cho ga'o// bsgrub par 'dod na/ gos gtsang ma bgo/ kha zas gtsang ma bza'/ dben pa'i sa phyogs gtsang mar/ khrus dang gtsang sbra la gnas pas/ stan dkar po gtsang ma la 'dug ste/ rang sngar bshad pa lta bu'i lha mo yig 'bru dang bcas par bsgom/ thugs ka'i 'khor lo yig 'bru dang bcas pa las 'od zer sna bug g.yas nas song*/ lho phyogs rgya mtsho'i 'gram nas lha mo 'khor dang bcas pa spyan drangs/

mdun gyi nam mkhar bzhugs pa la mchod pas mchod/ oṃ swa ra swa sti me hṛ di tiṣ+ṭha hrīṃḥ zhes brjod pas dam tshig pa'i lus ngag yid gsum la ye shes pa'i lus ngag yid gsum thim ste gnyis su med par bsgom zhing*/ lus kyi dmigs pa de dang ma bral ba'i ngang nas/ thugs ka'i hrīṃḥlas hrīṃḥmu tig gi do shal lta bu kha nas thon/ lte ba nas zhugs/ hrīṃḥl thim zhing*/ 'od zer spro bsdu'i dmigs pa rjes gnang du bshad pa dang 'dra bas hrīṃḥzhes pa 'bum phrag lnga bsnyen pa bya'o// sgrub pa'i dus su bsnyen pa dang 'dra ba las khyad par spogs pa'i cho ga mdun gyi 'khor lo la mchod cing*/ 'khor lo de rjes gnang gi dus kyi slob dpon dang 'dra ba'i mdun bskyed la ye shes pa spyan drangs la bstim/ gsung gi rjes gnang dang 'dra ba'i dngos grub len cing*/ rang sngags las sngags phreng lte ba nas 'thon/ mdun bskyed kyi lte ba nas zhugs 'khor lo la thim zhal nas 'thon/ rang gi zhal nas zhugs/ 'khor lor thim par bsgom pa yin gsungs/ lha mo dbyangs can ma'i sgrub thabs so// paṇ+ḍi ta chen po sa man+ta shrīs rgya gar nub phyogs kyi paṇ+ḍi ta shrī dz+nyā na bha dra mu nīn+d+ra la/ de la bdag sgra tshad pa rin chen rnam rgyal gyis zhus shing*/ zab pa'i khyad chos rnams paṇ+ḍi ta nyid kyis na ga ra'i yi ger tho tsher bkod pa las/ dus phyis shes bya rig pa'i gnas rnams la/ blo gros kyi snang ba phyin ci ma log par rgyas pa'i sde snod 'dzin pa chen po mdo khams stod pa brtson 'grus dpal gyis bskul ba'i ngor/ lcags pho byi ba'i lo dpyid zla tha chung gi tshes brgyad kyi nyin paṇ+ḍi ta'i phyag len yi ger bkod pa'i yi ge pa ni dpal mchog don grub bo// ༈ /dbyangs can lha mo'i sgrub thabs dang rjes gnang bya tshul bzhugs so// swa sti/ skyabs 'gro sems bskyed tshad med bzhi bsgom/

oṃ swa bhā wa sogs kyis sbyang*/ stong pa'i ngang las pad+ma dkar po 'dab ma stong dang ldan pa'i lte bar zla ba'i dkyil 'khor gyi steng du/ rang skad cig gis lha mo dbyangs can ma sku mdog dkar mo shel dkar dri ma med pa ltar phyi bltas nang gsal/ nang bltas phyi gsal ba 'od zer dkar po 'phro ba zhal gcig phyag gnyis kyis baiḍūr+ya'i pi waṃ rgyud stong dang ldan pa sgreng bas lha dang dri za dang rig pa 'dzin pa la sogs pa skye 'phags thams cad kyi yid 'phrog par mdzad pa dbu skra bung ba ltar gnag pa'i thor cog cung zad dang bcas pa la me tog dkar po'i phreng bas bcings pa/ lhag ma rgyab tu 'phyang ba la rin po che sna tshogs kyis spras pa/ gser gyi rna cha la rin po che sna tshogs pa'i phra bkod pas mkhur tshos mdzes par byas pa/ rin po che sna tshogs kyi dbu rgyan dang snyan rgyan la sogs pa khra chabs se/ khril le/ sil khrol gyi sgra snyan par sgrags pa/ gzhon nu lo bcu drug lon pa ltar lang tsho dar la bab pa/ reg na bde ba bskyed pa'i nu ma gnyis mkhrang zhing rgyas pa/ chags pa'i nyams dang ldan pas g.yon du 'gying zhing*/ spyan zur gyis gzigs pa/ kā tsa li kā'i stod g.yogs dang smad g.yogs bsnams pa/ me tog dkar po'i chun 'phyang gis mdzes pa/ spyi gtsug zla ba'i dkyil 'khor dri ma med pas brgyan pa/ zhabs gnyis tsog pu'i tshul gyis bzhugs pa/ rang gi snying mgo mthur bstan du yod pa blos gyen bslangs te tshal pa brgyad du gyes pa pad+ma dkar po 'dab ma brgyad pa'i ze'u 'bru dmar ser gyis bskor ba'i lte bar zla ba'i dkyil 'khor gyi dbus su rang sems kyi ngo bo hrīṃḥdang*/ 'dab ma brgyad la mdun nas brtsams te g.yas skor du a ā sogs nas/ aṃ aḥste yig 'bru zung re gnas pa rnams cung zad gdan la ma reg pa 'dar zhing 'khor lo dang yig 'bru rnams dkar zhing 'tsher ba'i 'od zer gyi drwa bas snying gi mun pa sel ba'i nus pa dang ldan par bsam/

thugs ka'i 'khor lo yig 'bru dang bcas pa las 'od zer sna bug g.yas pa nas song*/ lho phyogs rgya mtsho'i 'gram nas lha mo dbyangs can ma la sangs rgyas dang byang chub sems dpa'i tshogs kyis bskor ba oṃ badz+ra sa mā dzaḥ zhes pas spyan drang*/ de la/ oṃ swa ra swa sti oṃ ar+ghaṃ sogs kyis mchod/ oṃ swa ra swa sti me hṛ da ya tiṣ+ṭha hrīṃḥ zhes pas gnyis su med par bstim/ thugs ka'i hrīṃḥlas hrīṃḥgi phreng ba mu tig gi do shal lta bu zhal nas 'thon/ lte ba nas zhugs hrīṃḥl thim zhing*/ 'od zer dkar po phyogs bcur 'phros pas 'jig rten gyi khams na bzhugs pa'i sangs rgyas dang byang chub sems dpa' 'phags pa nyan thos dang*/ rang sangs rgyas/ grub pa thob pa'i dpa' bo dang rnal 'byor ma dang*/ mkhas pa paṇ+ḍi ta dang*/ rig pa 'dzin pa dang*/ smon lam la dbang ba'i drang srong rnams dang*/ rgyal po dang*/ blon po dang*/ gzhon nu ma dang*/ rin po che dang*/ sman dang*/ rtsi bcud la sogs pa thams cad kyi shes rab dang*/ spobs pa dang*/ gzungs dang*/ mkhyen pa dang*/ brtse ba dang*/ nus mthu dang*/ gzi brjid dang*/ tshe dang bsod nams la sogs pa'i nus mthu rnams rdo khab len gyis lcags sdud pa bzhin bsdus te/ rang gi kha nas zhugs 'khor lo yig 'bru dang bcas pa la thim pas shes bya thams cad la blo gros thogs pa med par rgyas shing*/ nus mthu dang*/ gzi brjid phun sum tshogs pa dang ldan par gyur ces bsam/ ngag tu hrīṃḥzhes brgya rtsa dang*/ hrīṃḥ a ā sogs nas aṃ aḥ zhes bdun nam nyer gcig bzla'o// bsnyen pa ni/ sngags snga ma la 'bum phrag lnga bzla'o// sgra dbyangs lha mo dbyangs can mas bdag dang sems can thams cad la bdag med rtogs pa'i shes rab khyad par can skye bar byin gyis brlab tu gsol/ zhes gsol ba gdab bo// maṇ+ḍal/ oṃ a mṛ te hūm̐ phaṭa kyis bsang*/ swa bhā was sbyang*/ stong pa'i ngang las pad+ma dkar po 'dab ma stong dang ldan pa'i lte bar zla ba'i dkyil 'khor gyi steng du skad cig gis lha mo dbyangs can ma sogs nas ldan par bsam pa'i bar dang*/

rang gi thugs kyi ngo bo hrīṃḥlas 'od zer dkar po sna bug g.yas pa nas phyir 'phros pas lho phyogs rgya mtsho'i sogs nas med par thim zhes pa'i bar brjod/ oṃ swa ra swa sti tiṣ+ṭha hrīṃḥ a ā nas aḥbar nyer gcig bzlas pas brtan par bsams la/ mchod pa byin gyis brlabs nas/ oṃ swa ra swa sti re re'i mgor sbyar ba'i oṃ badz+ra prok+ṣa ṇa sogs nas shab+da āḥhūm̐ dang*/ oṃ badz+ra dharmā ra ṇi sogs brjod/ rgyal ba kun gyi gsung rab sogs kyis bstod/ gtor ma byin rlabs ni/ bsang sbyang*/ stong pa'i ngang las oṃ las byung ba'i rin po che las grub pa'i snod yangs shing rgya che ba'i nang du gtor ma kha dog dri ro nus pa phun sum tshogs pa bdud rtsi'i rgya mtsho chen por gyur/ oṃ āḥhūm̐ lan gsum/ oṃ swa ra swa sti sa pa ri wā ra oṃ a kā ro sogs lan gsum gyis phul/ oṃ swa ra swa sti sa pa ri wā ra oṃ badz+ra prok+ṣa ṇa sogs nas shab+da āḥhūm̐ gis mchod/ rgyal ba kun gyi gsung rab sogs kyis bstod/ slob ma'i snying la dbab par mdzad du gsol/ ma rig pa'i mun pa bsal du gsol/ ye shes kyi snang ba bskyed du gsol/ nyon mongs pa'i drwa ba bcad du gsol/ ma rig pa'i ling tog bsal du gsol/ bdag med rtogs pa'i shes rab khyad par can bskyed du gsol/ zhes gsol ba btab pa'i rjes su/ oṃ aḥswa ra swa sti mi tiṣ+ṭha ku ru hūm̐/ mdun gyi lha mo rang la thim/ hrīṃḥbargya rtsa sogs bzla'o// de nas slob ma bcu bdun las mi mang ba rnams khrus bya/ ras dkar gyi steng du pad+ma 'dab brgyad bri/ de'i steng du ku sha rtse mo mdun la bstan pa'i steng du tsog pur bzhag las kyi rdo rjes me tog bkye bsdu grub rjes/ slob dpon gyis sems bskyed gsal btab nas/ 'dir rgyas pa yin/ de la du ma zhig yod pa las da lan 'dir ma rig pa'i mun pa bsal nas bdag med rtogs pa'i shes rab bskyed par bya ba'i phyir du paṇ+ḍi ta chen po sa man+ta shrīs rgya gar nub phyogs kyi paṇ+ḍi ta shrī dz+nyā na bha dra la bka' babs pa'i sgra dbyangs lha mo dbyangs can ma'i rjes su gnang ba zab mo sgrub par byed pa la gnyis las/

dang po slob dpon gyi bgyi bar 'os pa rnams grub nas/ gnyis pa slob ma'i bya ba la/ maṇ+ḍal phul ba/ dus gsum sangs rgyas sogs dang*/ dkon mchog gsum la sogs kyis kha bskangs pa rnams rjes gnang gi sngon 'gro yin/ dngos gzhi la thog mar sku'i rjes su gnang ba'i slad du dmigs ba 'di bzhin mdzod/ slob dpon gyi thugs ka nas 'od zer 'phros/ khyed rang gi lus la phog pas sdig sgrib sbyangs nas/ de la dmigs te oṃ swa bhā wa sogs nas ma lus pa sel ba'i nus pa dang ldan pa'i sku can du gyur pa yin snyam du mos nas/ slob dpon gyis khyed rnams kyi stan byin gyis brlab pa'i slad du rdo rje rtse gsum pa'i phyag rgyas reg ste ngag tu/ oṃ ā dha ra shak+ti ka ma la ā sa na dā na daḥ zhes byin gyis brlabs par mos nas/ gsol ba 'debs pa 'di'i rjes zlos mdzod/ oṃ aṅguṣ+ṭha ya na maḥ oṃ tardza n+yai na maḥ oṃ mā dh+ya mā ye na maḥ oṃ a nā mi kā ye na maḥ oṃ ka niṣ+ṭha kā ye na maḥ oṃ kār+ya ka pṛṣ+ṭi bh+yo na maḥ oṃ swa ra swa sti me tiṣ+ṭha ku ru hūm̐/ zhes gsol ba btab pa'i rkyen gyis slob dpon gyi thugs ka nas 'od zer 'phros pas mdun bskyed dang lho phyogs rgya mtsho'i 'gram nas sgra dbyangs lha mo dbyangs can ma'i sku mar me gcig las gnyis chad kyi sku bsam gyis mi khyab pa che ba ri rab tsam chung ba rdul phran tsam tshad med grangs mi phyed pa'i rnam par spyan drangs te khyed rang rnams kyi spyi bo'i gtsug ba spu'i bu ga dbang po'i sgo la sogs pa rnams nas mar mtsho chen po la kha ba babs pa ltar sib sib thim pas lha mo'i sku dang dbyer med du rgyud byin gyis brlabs pa'i mos pa mdzod/ khyed rang rnams kyis slob dpon la drin lan gyi tshul gyis me tog gtor te 'di'i rjes zlos lan gsum mdzod/ lha mo bdag la stsal lags kyi// bdag la 'go bar mdzad du gsol// lan gsum/

khyed rang rnams kyi me tog gi phreng ba phul ba de slob dpon gyis slob ma'i spyi bor me tog bzhag ste brten par byas pa'i mos pa mdzod/ lha mo 'di la stsal lags kyi// lha mo 'di la byin gyis rlobs// lan gsum/ zhes brjod nas slob dpon gyis rdo rje rtse gsum pa'i phyag rgya snying ga sogs su reg pas brtan par mos/ oṃ hṛ da yā ya tiṣ+ṭha/ gtsug tor/ oṃ shi ra si swā hā/ spyi bor/ oṃ shi khā yai bauṣaṭa/ gsang gnas/ oṃ ka ba tsā ye hūm̐/ mig gnyis/ oṃ nai tra ya bo ṣaṭe/ lag gnyis oṃ hastā ya phaṭa/ ces sku yi rjes su gnang ba yin/ gsung gi rjes su gnang ba'i slad du dmigs pa 'di bzhin mdzod/ slob dpon lha mo dbyangs can ma'i skur gsal ba'i thugs ka'i 'khor lo las hrīṃḥlas hrīṃḥgi phreng ba mu tig gi phreng ba bstar la brgyus pa ltar bsam gyis mi khyab pa zhal nas byung ste/ de las 'od zer dkar po phyogs bcur sogs nas ldan par mos nas/ dpon slob gnyis kas phreng ba bzung ste sngags 'di'i rjes zlos brgya rtsa brgyad mdzod/ hrīṃḥdang*/ sngags 'di'i rjes zlos nyer gcig mdzod/ hrīṃḥ.a ā sogs bzla'o// slob dpon gyis phreng ba khyed rang gi mgo bor bzhag par mos pa mdzod/ oṃ hrīṃḥwa ra wā ka thā dī na maḥ zhes brjod cing phreng ba ske la bskon zhing*/ de gsung gi rjes su gnang ba yin/ thugs kyi rjes gnang gi slad du dmigs pa 'di bzhin mdzod/ slob dpon lha mo dbyangs can mar gsal ba'i thugs ka'i yig 'bru las yig 'bru rang gi rnam pa rin po che'i sgron me bstar la brgyus pa lta bu bsam gyis mi khyab pa byung*/ de dag las 'od zer 'phros pas 'jig rten gyi khams na bzhugs pa'i sangs rgyas sogs nas bsdus te khyod rang gi zhal du zhugs/ thugs ka'i 'khor lo yig 'bru dang bcas pa la thim pas lha mo dbyangs can ma'i thugs dang rang gi sems dbyer med du gyur pas phyi nang gi ma rig pa'i mun pa rnams bsal nas shes bya la blo gros thogs pa med par rgyas shing byin gyis brlabs par mos pa byas la ting lo'i mar me spar ba de slob ma'i khar bcug

slob dpon gyis hrīṃḥ.a ā sogs brjod cing byin nas/ de nyid brtan par bya ba'i phyir du 'di'i rjes zlos lan gsum mdzod/ oṃ swa ra swa sti me hṛ da yo tiṣ+ṭha hrīṃḥ a ā sogs nas/ aṃ aḥzhes brtan par bya ba ni thugs kyi rjes su gnang ba yin/ des dngos gzhi grub nas/ rjes kyi chos gsum 'dra'o// rjes mchod bstod gshegs gsol dam tshig pa rang la thim/ gnas gsum bsrung*/ bsngo ba dang bkra shis sogs bya'o// zhes pa 'di ni rang gi dran pa gso phyir du dpal ldan bla ma dam pa mkhyen rab kyi dbang phyug pradz+nya dh+wa dza'i zhabs la gtugs pa'i bha dan+ta ga ga na shrī bha dras shrī e wam̐ thar pa rtser sug bris su byas pa'o// 'dis 'gro ba rnams kyi mi shis pa'i mun pa bsal nas yang dag pa'i shes rab thob par shog /sarba dā maṅga laṃ// ༈ /dbyangs can ma'i sgrub thabs rjes gnang gi kha skong bzhugs so// dbyangs can ma'i rjes gnang la/ sbyor dngos rjes gsum las/ dang po yi ge ltar bya zhing*/ mchod pa chu bzhi nyer spyod/ gtor ma gcig dang bcas pa mthong ba brgyud pa'i phyag len ltar bya'o// gnyis pa ni/ mchod pa bsangs sbyangs nas/ byin rlabs chu bzhi sogs kyi sngags oṃ badz+ra ar+ghaṃ swā hā/ oṃ badz+ra pā d+yaṃ swā hā/ oṃ badz+ra āñca ma naṃ swā hā/ oṃ badz+ra prok+ṣa ṇa swā hā/ oṃ badz+ra puṣ+pe nas shab+da swā hā/ oṃ badz+ra dharmā ra ṇi sogs brjod/ skyabs 'gro sems bskyed sngon du 'gro bas tshad med bzhi bsgom/ swa bha was stong par sbyang*/ stong pa'i ngang las pad+ma dkar po 'dab ma stong dang ldan pa'i lte bar zla ba'i dkyil 'khor dri ma med pa'i steng du lha mo dbyangs can ma sku mdog shel dkar po dri ma med pa ltar phyi bltas na nang gsal ba 'od zer dkar po 'phro ba dang bcas pa/ tsog pu'i tshul du bzhugs pa/ dbu skra sogs nas ma lus pa sel bar bsgom/ thugs ka'i 'khor lo yig 'bru sogs nas 'dra bas hrīṃḥsogs bzla/

sgra dbyangs lha mo dbyangs can mas bdag dang sems can thams cad la bdag med rtogs pa'i shes rab khyad par can skye bar byin gyis brlab tu gsol/ zhes 'dod pa'i don la gsol ba gdab/ mdun bskyed mchod bstod gtor ma bzlas pa'i bar grub rjes/ slob ma bcu bdun las mi mang ba rnams khrus bya/ ras dkar gyi steng du rdul tshon gyis pad+ma 'dab brgyad bri/ de'i steng du ku sha rtse mo mdun la bstan pa'i steng du slob ma rnams tsog bur bzhag las kyi slob mas me tog bkye bsdu grub rjes/ slob dpon gyis sems bskyed gsal btab nas rjes gnang zhu ba'i maṇ+ḍal/ dus gsum sogs dang*/ dkon mchog gsum la sogs kyis kha bskangs pa ni rjes gnang gi sngon 'gro yin/ dngos gzhi la sku gsung thugs kyi rjes su gnang ba rnams yi ge ltar bya'o// rjes gtso bos/ maṇ+ḍal/ deng nas sogs brjod/ gsum pa ni mchod bstod sogs spyi'i rigs 'gre sbyar te shes par bya'o// zhes pa'i tho yig 'di ni bya bral bas brjed pas 'jigs nas bris pa'o// brgyud yig ni 'jam pa'i dbyangs dkon mchog lhun grub pa'i gsan yig ltar las/ rje bla ma shar khang pa shes rab rgyal mtshan/ des bdag bik+ṣu ga ga na shrī bha dra la'o// sngags thung brgya rtsa dang sngags ring nyer gcig gi rjes zlos bya'o// bha wan+tu// ༈ /lha mo dbyangs can ma'i bsnyen thabs bzhugs// swa sti/ lha mo dbyangs can ma'i bsnyen pa byed par 'dod pa'i rnal 'byor pas 'di'i rjes gnang lung dang bcas pa thob cing dam tshig dang sdom par ldan zhing sha chang sgog btsong la sogs pa'i bza' btung spangs nas gtsang sbra la gnas pa/ khyad par gyi dam tshig brdzun mi smra/ stan dang sga la sogs pa sngas su mi 'jug rang nyal ba'i steng du l+h+wam krad sogs mi gtsang ba mi 'ong bar bya/ dung sogs lha'i phyag mtshan dang chos yig 'bru tsam la'ang mi 'gom/ rang nyid shes rab che bar rloms pa'i nga rgyal dang phrag dog spang*/

tshe 'di'i snyan grags sogs 'dod pa'i blo spangs shing dal 'byor rnyed dka'/ 'chi ba mi rtag 'khor ba'i nyes dmigs bsam pa rnams kyis skyo shes nges par 'byung ba bskyed/ sems can rnams pha mar shes pas byams snying rjes kun nas bslangs te gtan gyi 'dun ma dkon mchog la blo gtad/ bsnyen pa byed pa'i gnas bud med kyi rgyu 'grul med pa'i sar bya/ lha mo'i sku sogs dkon mchog gi rten yod na bsham/ ma 'byor na'ang skyon med/ stegs bu ji ltar rigs par dkar gtor zlum po la theb kyu bzhis bskor ba dang*/ de'i mdun du chu gnyis sngon 'gro'i nyer spyod lnga bsham/ sgrub pa la 'jug khar tshogs bsags rim gro dag grub na bya/ rnam 'joms sme brtsegs sogs bzlas pa'i bum chu 'thung zhing khrus bya/ 'di thun mtshams su byung na legs/ rnam 'joms sme brtsegs sogs kyi bzlas pa'ang ci rigs bya/ gza' skar sogs 'phrod sbyor bzang po yod pa'i yar ngo la sgrub pa la 'jug gnas khang mal sa gu gul gyis bdug cha gsum yid ches nges ba zhig btang ste/ sgrub pa mthar ma phyin gyi bar gyi bar chad zhi ba'i phrin las bcol/ nag po'i rigs kyi bgegs rigs la gtor ma sbyin te bskrad/ thog mar bka' drin che ba'i bla ma la gsol ba btab cing skyabs 'gro mang du bya/ sgrub thabs paṇa chen nam mkha' dpal bzang gis mdzad pa de byed/ 'di sgrub thabs tshig tshogs nyung bas thun bzhi bya thun mtshams su gtor ma 'bul pa ni/ gtor ma chu gtsang gis bran te/ oṃ āḥhūm̐ lan gsum gyi bar dang*/ gtor mgron rgyas par na/ gtor ma'i steng gi nam mkhar pad+ma dkar po 'dab ma stong dang ldan pa'i sogs nas gnyis su med par bstim/ zhes pa'i bar bdag mdun gyi khyad par rang nyid ces dang rang gi zhes pa dor ba ma gtogs mngon rtogs ltar bskyed/ bris sku sogs dmigs rten yod na de la dmigs rten bya/

de tsam mi nus na/ rang gi thugs ka'i 'khor lo yig 'bru dang bcas pa las 'od zer sna bug g.yas pa nas song lho phyogs rgya mtsho'i 'gram nas lha mo dbyangs can ma la sangs rgyas dang byang chub sems dpa'i tshogs kyis bskor ba gtor ma'i steng gi nam mkhar oṃ badz+ra sa mā dzaḥ zhes pas spyan drangs pa tsam gyis chog gang ltar yang gtor ma 'bul ba dngos ni/ oṃ swa ra swa sti sogs kyis 'bul/ mchod pa chu bzhi chu gnyis gang rung sngon 'gro'i nyer spyod kyis mchod/ rgyal ba kun gyi gsung rab sogs kyis bstod/ sgra dbyangs lha mo sogs kyis gsol ba gdab/ tshig ris rnams sgrub thabs dang rjes gnang gi mdun bskyed skabs na yod/ rten yod na brtan bzhugs bya/ med na gshegs gsol lam mi dmigs pa gang bde bya/ de nas yang thun mtshams su/ dri za tum+bu ru la chung ma dbyangs can ma dang nor rgyun ma gnyis yod pa las/ de gnyis phan tshun phrag dog byed pas/ gcig mchod na gcig khro bas/ des na dbyangs can ma bsgrub na nor rgyun ma khros te longs spyod la gnod pas na/ mkhas pa phal cher dbul por gnas zhes 'byung bas/ de bsal ba ni thun mtshams thams cad du snod gtsang mar theb kyu gtsang ma re bzhag de la chu blugs te/ oṃ āḥhūm̐ lan gsum brjod pas bdud rtsir byin gyis brlabs te/ gtor mgron rgyas par nor rgyun ma bskyed bstim bya bar gsungs la/ bsdus pa ni/ rang gi snying ga nas 'od zer 'phros pas lha mo nor rgyun ma mdun gyi nam mkha' oṃ badz+ra sa mā dzaḥ zhes pas spyan drangs te/ oṃ bā su dhā ri ṇi bam̐ swā hā/ zhes pa nyer gcig gam lnga'am bdun gyis gtor ma phul bas mnyes par bsam zhing*/ bdag la zas nor gyi dngos grub rgya chen po stsal du gsol/ zhes gsol ba drag tu btab pas zas nor gyi char chen po bab par bsams la rang skad cig gis nor rgyun ma sku mdog ser mo zhal gcig phyag gnyis ma g.yas mchog sbyin/

g.yon 'bras kyi snye ma dang rin po che'i gter gyi bum pa 'dzin pa dar dang rin po che'i rgyan gyis brgyan pa zhabs rdo rje'i skyil krung gis pad zla'i gdan la bzhugs par bsams la/ de'i thugs kar bam̐ yig gi mthar sngags phreng gis bskor bar dmigs te/ oṃ bā su dhā ri ṇi hūm̐ swā hā/ zhes pa ci rigs bzla/ 'od zer ser po phyogs bcur 'phros nas 'jig rten gyi khams kyi zas nor dang longs spyod thams cad bsdus/ rang gi khog par thim pas lus kyi nang khengs nas gzi brjid dang bkrag mdangs tshe dang bsod nams thams cad rgyas par bsam/ bsnyen pa'i skabs kyi thun mtshams kun tu 'di bsgom mo// 'di ni nor sgrub tu'ang 'gyur ro// bsnyen tshad la grangs bsnyen 'bum phrag lnga kha skong khri tsho lnga dang bcas pa'i zhag bdun nam nyer gcig sogs gang rigs dang*/ rtags thon bsnyen pa ni/ sngar bas lce bde ba/ dran pa gsal ba/ gzhung mang du 'dzin pa sogs dang*/ rmi lam gyi rtags ni/ gzhon nu ma gtsang mas gos dkar po gyon nas dkar gsum gyi zas ster ba zos pa dang*/ shel dang thod le kor gyi phreng ba gtod pa/ chu gtsang ma'i rgyun la 'thung ba sogs rmi bar bshad/ grangs ma tshang par rtags byung na'ang grangs tshang bar bya dgos/ rtags lan gcig la ma byung na nam byung byung bskyar dgos so/ bsnyen pa song nas kyang snga dro sngags brgya rtsa re ma chag pa byed do// bogs 'don gegs sel sogs rgyas par yi ge rnying pa dang ngag las btsal bar bya'o// 'di yang snga phyir don gnyer mang pos yang yang bskul nas dge slong snyom las pa sangs rgyas phun tshogs kyis e waṃ chos ldan du bris pa 'di'i dge bas bdag sogs sems can thams cad kyis bdag med rtogs pa'i shes rab rgyud la skye ba'i rgyur gyur cig/ ༈ /dbyangs can ma'i nyams len gyi yan lag bzhugs// swa sti/ dbyangs can lha mo'i sgrub yig gnad// bka' thob sdig spangs tshangs spyod ldan// brdzun dang sha chang sgog btsong spang*// khrus dang gtsang sbra gnas gtsang ldan// 'jig rten tshe 'di'i che thabs spang*// phyi ma'i byang chub snying nas bsam// bzlas pa'i skabs kyi hrīṃḥ'akhor tshul// klad kor nā da las spro zhing*// mgal me'i 'khor lo ltar 'khor zhing*// rnam pa mu tig do shal 'dra// de 'grub rtags ni mngon sum du// lce bde dran gsal gzhung mang 'dzin// rmi lam gzhon nus dkar gsum ster// shel dang thod le kor dang phreng*// chu gtsang rgyun 'thung la sogs rmi// rtags 'di rnams ni ma byung bar// srog dang bsdos te bsgrub par bya// bzlas tshe mi tshig bar ma gcod// 'dis kyang phan bde nges par ster// zhes pa 'di yang sangs rgyas phun tshogs kyis sgrub thabs nyams len gyi yan lag tu bris pa'o//

༈ /sgra dbyangs lha mo dbyangs can dkar mo paṇ+ḍi ta sa man+ta shrī nas brgyud pa'i sgrub thabs rjes gnang dang bcas pa shes rab dpal 'bar zhes bya ba bzhugs so// oṃ swa sti/ bla ma dang gnyis su med pa'i dbyangs can lha mo'i zhabs la gus pas phyag 'tshal lo// shes bya kun la thogs pa med pa'i blo gros stsal du gsol/ de la 'dir paṇ+ḍi ta chen po sa man+ta shrī nas brgyud pa'i sgra dbyangs lha mo'i rjes gnang bya bar/ sbyor dngos rjes gsum las// dang po ni/ gnas dben zhing nyams dga' bar rin po che'am/ shing ngam/ rdo la sogs pa khod snyoms pa chu gtsang mas dag par bkru/ rlan ma yal ba la dri bzang gi phyi ma bkram/ de'i steng du gser gyi thur mas pad+ma 'dab brgyad pa/ lte ba la zla ba'i dkyil 'khor/ de'i dbus su hrīṃḥ 'dab ma rnams la mdun nas g.yas skor du/ a ā/ i ī/ u ū/ ṛ ṝ/ l̥ l̥/ e ai/ o au/ aṃ aḥ zhes pa rnams bris la/ 'bras dkar po bzang gtsang gis ri mo'i steng nas mnan/ zan gtsang ma'i ting lo bcu bdun/ ba dmar ser gyi mar dang*/ sbrang rtsi sbyar bas bkang ba sdong bu dang bcas pa byas la/ yi ge re re'i mdun du dgod/ mañji'i steng du bzhag de'i shar du mchod yon/ zhabs bsil/ shar lhor zhal bsil/ lhor bsang gtor/ lho nub tu me tog nub tu spos mar me/ nub byang du dri chab/ byang du zhal zas/ byang shar du mtshams 'dzin/ mdun tu dkar gtor zlum po rnams dang*/ rang gi mdun du rdor dril/ 'thor nas/ slob mar dgos pa'i maṇ+ḍal/ me tog chu bcas bsham/ gnyis pa ni/ slob dpon rang nyid khrus bya/ gdong dri zhim pos byug kha dri zhim par bya/ gos dkar po dri ma med pa bgo zhing stan dkar po gtsang ma la bde bar 'dug ste/ mchod pa rnams/ oṃ a mṛ te hūm̐ phaṭa gyis bsang*/ oṃ swa bhā wa shud+dhaḥsarba dharmaḥswa bhā wa shud+dho3haṃ gis sbyang*/ stong pa'i ngang las oṃ las byung ba'i rin po che las grub pa'i snod yangs shing rgya che ba rnams kyi nang du oṃ zhu ba las byung ba'i lha rdzas las grub pa'i mchod yon/

zhabs bsil/ zhal bsil/ bsang gtor/ me tog bdug spos/ mar me/ dri chab/ zhal zas/ rol mo rnams dwangs shing thogs pa med pa nam mkha'i mtha' klas par gyur/ oṃ badz+ra ar+ghaṃ swā hā/ oṃ badz+ra pā d+yaṃ swā hā/ oṃ badz+ra āñca ma naṃ swā hā/ oṃ badz+ra prok+ṣa ṇaṃ swā hā/ oṃ badz+ra paṣ+pe swā hā nas/ oṃ badz+ra shab+da swā hā/ zhes chu bzhi la mchod yon gyi rgya dang*/ gzhan mchod pa so so'i phyag rgya'i mthar/ rdo rje 'dzin dril bu rgyun chags su dkrol la/ oṃ badz+ra dharmā ra ṇi sogs lan gsum brjod pas byin gyis brlab/ bdag dang 'gro ba nas/ 'phags pa'i dge 'dun rnams la skyabs su mchi'o// bar nyer gcig sogs/ bla ma dang dkon mchog rin po che rnam pa gsum la bdag phyag 'tshal zhing skyabs su mchi'o// khyed rnams kyis bdag gi rgyud byin gyis brlab tu gsol/ tshar gcig sems can thams cad kyi ma rig pa'i mun pa bsal nas shes rab kyi snang ba khyad par can la bzhag par bya/ de'i ched du sgra dbyangs lha mo dbyangs can ma'i sgom bzlas nyams su blang bar bgyi'o// lan gsum/ sems can thams cad bde ba dang sogs tshad med bzhi bsgom/ oṃ swa bhā wa sogs kyis sbyang*/ stong pa'i ngang las pad+ma dkar po 'dab ma stong dang ldan pa'i lte bar zla ba'i dkyil 'khor gyi steng du rang skad cig gis lha mo dbyangs can ma sku mdog dkar mo shel dkar po dri ma med pa ltar/ phyi bltas nang gsal ba/ nang bltas phyi gsal ba/ 'od zer dkar po 'phro ba dang bcas pa zhal gcig phyag gnyis kyis baiḍūr+ya sngon po'i pi waṃ rgyud stong dang ldan pa sgreng bas lha dang*/ dri za dang*/ rig pa 'dzin pa la sogs pa skye 'phags thams cad kyi yid 'phrog par mdzad pa/ dbu skra 'jam zhing mnyen pa/ bung ba ltar gnag pa/ thor cog cung zad dang bcas pa la me tog dkar po'i phreng ba bcings pa/ lhag ma rgyab tu 'phyang ba la rin po che sna tshogs pa'i rgyan gyis spras pa/

gser gyi rna cha la rin po che sna tshogs pa'i phra bkod pas mkhur tshos mdzes par brgyan pa/ dbu rgyan/ mgul rgyan/ snyan rgyan/ do shal/ phyag gdub/ zhabs gdub rnams rin po che sna tshogs pas khra chabs se khrol le sil khrol gyi sgra snyan par sgrogs pa/ gzhon nu ma lo bcu drug lon pa'i rnam pa can lang tsho dar la babs pa/ reg na bde ba skyed pa'i nu ma gnyis mkhrang zhing rgyas pa chags pa'i nyams dang ldan pas g.yon du 'gying zhing*/ spyan zur mig gis gzigs pa/ ka tsa li kā'i stod g.yogs dang*/ smad g.yogs me tog gi tshom bus spras pa/ pad+ma dkar po'i chun 'phyang gis mdzes par brgyan cing*/ spyi gtsug zla ba'i dkyil 'khor dri ma med pas brgyan pa/ tsog pu'i tshul du bzhugs pa/ rang gi snying mgo thur bstan du yod pa blos gyen du bslangs te/ tshal pa brgyad phyir gyes pa/ pad+ma dkar po 'dab ma brgyad pa dkar zhing 'jam pa ze'u 'bru dmar ser gyis bskor ba'i mtshams nas nyi ma stong dang mnyam pa'i 'od zer 'phro ba/ lte ba'i steng na zla ba'i dkyil 'khor nya gang ba dri ma med pa'i dbus su/ sems kyi ngo bo yi ge hrīṃḥdakar po ring cha zla tshes thig le dang bcas pa/ 'dab ma rnams la mdun nas brtsams te g.yas skor du/ a ā/ i ī/ u ū/ ṛ ṝ/ l̥ l̥̄/ e ai/ o au/ aṃ aḥ rnams 'dab ma re re la yi ge gnyis gnyis gnas pa/ thams cad kyang shel dkar po dri ma med pa ltar dngas shing gsal ba/ ldem me bzhengs nas gdan la ma reg tsam cung zad 'dar zhing*/ 'khor lo yi ge dang bcas pa'i 'od zer gyi drwa bas snying gi mun pa ma lus pa sel ba'i nus pa dang ldan pa/ thugs ka'i 'khor lo yig 'bru dang bcas pa las/ 'od zer sna bug g.yas nas song*/ lho phyogs rgya mtsho'i 'gram nas lha mo dbyangs can ma la sangs rgyas dang byang chub sems dpa'i tshogs kyis bskor ba mdun gyi nam mkhar oṃ badz+ra sa mā dzaḥ

oṃ swa ra swa sti sa pa ri wā ra ar+ghaṃ/ pā d+yaṃ/ āñca ma naṃ/ prok+ṣa ṇaṃ/ puṣ+pe/ dhū pe/ ā lo ke/ gan+dhe/ nai wi d+ya/ shab+da pra tīts+tsha swā hā/ oṃ swa ra swa sti me hṛ da ya tiṣ+ṭha hrīṃḥzhes pas gnyis su med par thim/ thugs ka'i hrīṃḥlas hrīṃḥgi phreng ba mu tig gi do shal lta bu zhal nas thon/ lte ba nas zhugs hrīṃḥl thim zhing 'od zer dkar po phyogs bcur 'phros pas 'jig rten gyi khams na bzhugs pa'i sangs rgyas dang byang chub sems dpa'/ 'phags pa nyan thos dang*/ rang sangs rgyas/ grub pa thob pa'i rnal 'byor pa dang*/ mkhas pa paṇ+ḍi ta/ rig pa 'dzin pa/ smon lam la dbang ba'i drang srong dang*/ rgyal po dang*/ blon po dang*/ bu mo gzhon nu ma la sogs pa dang*/ rin po che'i rigs dang*/ sman dang*/ rtsi bcud la sogs pa thams cad kyi shes rab dang*/ spobs pa dang*/ gzungs dang*/ mkhyen pa dang*/ brtse ba dang*/ nus mthu dang*/ gzi brjid dang*/ tshe dang bsod nams la sogs pa'i nus mthu rnams rdo khab len gyis lcags sdud pa bzhin bsdus te/ rang gi kha nas zhugs/ 'khor lo yig 'bru dang bcas pa la thim pas shes bya thams cad la blo gros thogs pa med par rgyas shing*/ nus mthu dang gzi brjid phun sum tshogs pa dang ldan par gyur/ zhes bsam/ ngag tu hrīṃḥbargya rtsa dang*/ hrīṃḥ.a ā sogs nas aṃ aḥ zhes bdun nam nyer gcig bzla'o// bsnyen pa ni sngags snga ma la 'bum phrag lnga bzla'o// gang ltar yang ji tsam bzlas pa'i mthar/ sgra dbyangs lha mo dbyangs can mas bdag dang sems can thams cad la bdag med rtogs pa'i shes rab khyad par can rgyud la skye bar byin gyis brlab tu gsol/ zhes gsol ba gdab bo// sgrub pa'i dus su bsnyen pa dang 'dra ba las/ khyad par spogs pa'i cho ga mdun gyi 'khor lo la mchod cing*/ mdun gyi 'khor lo de rjes gnang gi dus kyi slob dpon dang 'dra ba'i mdun bskyed la ye shes pa spyan drangs la bstim/

gsung gi rjes gnang dang 'dra ba'i dngos grub len zhing*/ rig sngags las sngags phreng lte ba nas thon nas/ mdun bskyed kyi lte ba nas zhugs/ 'khor lo la thim/ zhal nas 'thon/ rang gi zhal du zhugs te/ 'khor lo la thim pa sgom pa yin gsungs/ de nas mdun gyi maṇ+ḍal/ oṃ a mṛ te hūm̐ phaṭa kyis bsang*/ swa bhā was sbyang*/ stong pa'i ngang las pad+ma dkar po nas/ bzhugs pa bar bdag bskyed bzhin la/ de'i thugs kar pad+ma dkar po nas dbus su bar gong bzhin la/ thugs rnam par mi rtog pa'i ye shes kyi ngo bo hrīṃḥdakar po nas/ gnyis su med par thim par gong bzhin/ oṃ swa ra swa sti tiṣ+ṭha hrīṃḥ a ā nas/ aḥ'i bar nyer gcig bzlas pas brtan par bsams la/ mchod pa byin brlabs nas/ oṃ swa ra swa sti sa pa ri wā ra ar+ghaṃ pra tīts+tsha swā hā/ de bzhin rigs 'gre ba'i mthar/ rdo rje 'dzin dril bu gsil/ oṃ badz+ra dharmā ra ṇi sogs/ rgyal ba kun gyi gsung rab rgya mtsho yi// rnam par 'phrul pa'i dpal las legs byung zhing*// sgrub pa po la blo gros mchog ster ba// lha mo dbyangs can ma la phyag 'tshal lo// zhes sogs bstod pa rgyas bsdus gang shes kyis bstod/ gtor ma byin rlabs ni/ bsang sbyang*/ stong pa'i ngang las oṃ las byung ba'i rin po che las grub pa'i snod yangs shing rgya che ba'i nang du gtor ma kha dog dri ro nus pa phun sum tshogs pa bdud rtsi'i rgya mtsho chen por gyur/ oṃ āḥhūm̐/ lan gsum/ oṃ swa ra swa sti sa pa ri wā ra/ oṃ a kā ro sogs lan gsum gyis phul/ oṃ swa ra swa sti sa pa ri wā ra ar+ghaṃ sogs/ gong bzhin gyi mchod bstod mthar/ slob ma'i snying la 'bab par mdzad du gsol/ ma rig pa'i mun pa bsal du gsol/ ye shes kyi snang ba bskyed du gsol/ nyon mongs pa'i drwa ba bcad du gsol/ ma rig pa'i ling tog bsal du gsol/ bdag med rtogs pa'i shes rab khyad par can bskyed du gsol/

zhes sogs gsol ba gdab pa'i rjes la/ oṃ āḥswa ra swa sti me tiṣ+ṭha ku ru hūm̐/ zhes brjod pas mdun gyi lha mo rang la thim pas gnyis su med par bsgom/ hrīṃḥci nus bzla ba'am ma bzlas kyang chog de nas slob ma gcig nas bcu bdun bar lus ril por khrus lan gsum bya/ rlan ma bral ba la dri bzang gi chus lus thams cad byug kha dri zhim pos bsgo/ dar ram ras dkar po'i gos gtsang ma sngar longs ma spyad pa gyon/ ras dkar po gtsang ma'i gdan gyi steng du 'bras dkar po'i 'dab brgyad zla ba'i gdan dang bcas pa bri/ de'i steng du ku sha gsar pa rtse mo nang du bstan pa dgram/ de'i steng du tsog bu'i tshul gyis 'dug tu gzhug slob dpon gyis sems bskyed gsal 'debs sogs chos bshad ci rigs dang*/ 'dir skabs su babs pa ni/ lo rgyus rgyas par spro na/ 'phags ma dbyangs can ma ni/ theg pa chen po'i mdo sde gser 'od dam pa'i le'u bco lnga pa las/ btsun pa bcom ldan 'das lha mo dbyangs can ma chen mo bdag gis kyang dge slong chos smra ba de'i tshig brgyan pa'i slad du spobs pa nye bar bsgrub par bgyi/ gzungs kyang stsal bar bgyi sogs dang*/ phyag 'tshal bcom ldan dbyangs can mchog /byang chub chen po dbyangs can mchog /'phags pa rang rgyal dbyangs can mchog /zung bzhi ya brgyad dbyangs can mchog /bden pa bzhi gsung dbyangs can mchog /yang dag gzigs sogs dbyangs can mchog /drang srong tshangs 'khor dbyangs can mchog /lha mo u ma dbyangs can mchog /skem byed lha yang dbyangs can mchog /gzi byin klu yang dbyangs can mchog /mtshan mo'i lha mo dbyangs can mchog /rgyal chen bzhi po dbyangs can mchog /bde gnas lha sras dbyangs can mchog /rdo rje gsang bdag dbyangs can mchog /khyab 'jug lha yang dbyangs can mchog /lha mo sbed ma dbyangs can mchog /tshogs bdag lha yang dbyangs can mchog /dpal gyi lha mo dbyangs can mchog

/dpal gyi blo gros dbyangs can mchog /gī ri tshig 'chang dbyangs can mchog ma mo kun mchog dbyangs can mchog /'phrog ma mo yang dbyangs can mchog /gnod sbyin kun kyang dbyangs can mchog /phyogs bcu'i rgyal po dbyangs can mchog /bdag la las mchog kun gyi stobs// mtha' med dbyangs can mchog thob mdzod// phyag 'tshal lha mo mthu chen mo// 'jig rten khams 'dir dbang brnyes par// sngon gyi drang srong gis bshad pa// zhes dang*/ 'jig rten 'di skyed yum yang yin// gshin rje'i sring mor lus ston cing*// zhes dang*/ mdor na 'jig rten mthun par gzugs ston cing*// zhes bdud bzhi nyon mongs dang shes bya'i sgrib pa bag chags dang bcas gtan nas bcom shing*/ stobs bcu sogs byang phyogs so bdun la sogs pa rnam pa drug sogs dang ldan pa'i bcom ldan 'das kyi go 'phang mngon du mdzad zin kyang*/ sa bcu'i byang chub sems dpa' nas bzung ste 'jig rten dang mthun par gang la gang 'dul gyi gzugs ji snyed cig ston par bshad la/ za ma tog bkod pa'i mdo'i le'u dang po las/ rigs kyi bu de bzhin gshegs pa dgra bcom pa yang dag par rdzogs pa'i sangs rgyas rnam par gzigs zhes bya ba rig pa dang rkang par ldan pa/ bde bar gshegs pa/ 'jig rten mkhyen pa/ skyes bu 'dul ba'i kha lo bsgyur ba/ lha dang mi rnams kyi ston pa/ sangs rgyas bcom ldan 'das sngon 'jig rten du byung bar gyur to// de'i tshe de'i dus na ni spos kyi bzhin zhes bya ba'i tshong pa'i bur gyur te/ de'i tshe ngas de bzhin gshegs pa rnam par gzigs las spyan ras gzigs kyi dbang po'i yon tan brjod pa thos so// de nas bcom ldan 'das la byang chub sems dpa' sgrib pa thams cad rnam par sel bas 'di skad ces gsol to// bcom ldan 'das kyis byang chub sems dpa' chen po spyan ras gzigs kyi dbang po'i yon tan brjod pa ji skad du gsan/

bka' stsal pa/ mig las ni nyi ma dang zla ba byung*/ dpral ba las dbang phyug chen po/ phrag pa las ni tshangs pa/ snying las ni mthu bo che/ mche ba gnyis las ni lha mo dbyangs can/ kha las ni rlung las skyes pa rnams byung*/ rkang pa las ni sa/ lto ba las ni chu lha rnams byung bar gsungs pa sogs dang*/ rgyud sde las/ 'jam dpal gyi yum du'ang gsungs/ nges don du ngo bo sangs rgyas thams cad kyi yum shes rab kyi pha rol tu phyin ma yin kyang*/ snang tshul spyan ras gzigs kyi sras mo phyi nang gnyis ka'i yi dam gyi lhar 'dzin pas thugs rje ris med du 'jug cing*/ byin rlabs shin tu che bas khyad par du 'phags/ gdul bya thun mong ba'i snang ngor/ dkon mchog tā la'i bam po bzhi pa las/ rgya mtsho'i lha mo sgra ldan zhes bya ba// sems can rgya mtshor ji snyed skyes rnams kyi// sgra yi yan lag dbyangs kyi tshul mkhas te// rang gi skad kyis skad kun tshim par byed// sgra ldan chags sdang gti mug can de yang*// skad rnams kun gyi sgra yi tshul mkhas na// gzungs dang chos dang stobs la dbang thob rnams// lhar bcas 'jig rten ci phyir mgu mi phyed// tum+bu ru yi chung ma dbyangs ldan ma// tshangs pa'i bu mo yid las byung ba de// bden dang dam bcas mi 'tshe dga' rnams kyi// sems dang yid dang kha yi sgor 'jug ste// dbyangs ldan chags can zhe sdang can de yang*// brtul zhugs grub mthun dbyangs kyi yan lag gis// yid 'ong skad kyis 'jig rten mgu byed na// ye shes yon tan phyug rnams cis mi byed// zhes rgya mtsho'i lha mo sgra ldan ma chags sdang gti mug can des kyang rgya mtsho'i nang gi sems can rnams sgra'i tshul la mkhas pas tshim par byed la/ tum+bu ru'i chung ma dbyangs can ma'am tshangs pa'i bu mo zhe sdang dang ma bral ba des kyang sems can rnams kyi yid dang kha yi sgor zhugs te ngag gi 'dod pa sbyin par byed na/

byang chub sems dpa' stobs dang ye shes la dbang ba rnams kyis smos ci 'tshal/ zhes 'jig rten las ma 'das pa lta bur gsungs/ mkha' 'gro rgya mtsho/ rdo rje gur/ dgra nag 'jam dpal rtsa rgyud/ dpa' bo gcig grub sogs rgyud sde du ma nas 'jig rten las 'das par bstan zhing*/ yang rig byed kyi gtam rgyud ltar na/ 'jig rten 'di chags nas mi ring bar rdzogs ldan gyi thog ma'i skabs shig ri rab kyi lho phyogs rgya mtsho chen po bdud rtsi'i rang bzhin tu gnas pa la phyogs kun nas rlung bkod pa mtha' yas pa langs te/ des rgya mtsho'i rba rlabs rnam pa du ma g.yos pa las/ srid pa gsum gyi brtan g.yo'i sgra skad thams cad dri za'i glu'am mi'am ci'i dbyangs lta bur sgra rna bar snyan cing 'jebs pas dpag tshad bye bar khyab cing gnas so// de'i tshe tshangs pa chen po mi 'chi ba zhes bya ba tshangs pa'i grong khyer na spyod pas sgra de rab tu gsan nas lo brgya stong gi bar du rgya mtsho g.yo ba la bltas shing sgra de la mngon par dga' bas chags shing ro myong gin 'dug go /de'i tshe srid pa gsum gyi sgra dbyangs de rnams 'dus pa las/ lha mo zhes mtshan dang ldan pa 'jo sgeg shin tu rgyas pa sa 'og sa steng sa bla gsum na 'gran zla med pa phyag na tam+bu ra bsnams pa zhig byung ngo*// 'di'i yum gyi dod rgya mtsho yin/ tshangs pas bltas shing sgra der dga' zhing chags pa'i bsam pa ni pha'i sa bon gyi dod/ sgra dbyangs sna tshogs ni ma'i rdul gyi dod de/ de dag tshang pa las sku 'khrungs pas mtshan yang mtsho byung ma dang*/ rgya mtsho'i bu mo dang*/ tshangs pa'i sras mo dang*/ sgra dbyangs lha mo zhes grags so// lho phyogs kyi rgya mtsho de gshin rje chos kyi rgyal po'i gnas yin pas gshin rje'i sring mo zhes kyang ngo*// de nas gang gi tshe lha mo de nam mkha'i dkyil na 'dug ste/ gang skye bo rnams bden pa dang brtul zhugs dang ldan cing 'tshe ba med par 'dug pa na lha mo de dga' bas tam+bu ra'i dbyangs dang bstun nas gar dag byed pa na/

rgyud mangs de dang brtan g.yo thams cad las yid du 'ong ba'i sgra mtha' yas pa byung zhing*/ yid can rnams nyams bag bde la blo gros rgyas pas snyan pa'i dbyangs kyi don dpag tu med pa rang brjod par gyur to// lha dang gnod sbyin dang mi dang klu rnams spyod pa log par 'dug pa na/ lha mo de'ang phyir phyogs te 'dug na/ sgra thams cad nyams shing skye bo thams cad ldab ldib tu smra'o// de'i tshe dbyangs can ma zhes grags so// zhes dang*/ slob dpon dbyug pa can gyis kyang*// gdong bzhi gdong gi pad tshal gyi// ngang pa'i bu mo thams cad dkar// dbyangs can ma ni kho bo yi// yid la ring du rol par mdzod// zhes pa ltar snyan mngags/ mchod sbyin/ srid srung*/ nges brjod dang bcas gsung ba'i zhal bzhi dang ldan pa'i gdong pa de dag pad tshal gyi ngo bo'i gzugs su bkod/ sngon tshangs pa'i 'jig rten na chu klung gi gzugs kyis 'jig rten 'dir babs pa 'dzam gling lho phyogs su 'khyil pa tshangs pa'i mtsho zhes bya ba'i chu las rig byed kyi yi ge'i sgra rnams gdangs kyi tshul gyis 'byung ba yod la/ phyi rol rig byed pa rnams rig byed ni skyes bus ma byas pa'i bden pa'i don can yin no zhes 'dod cing*/ de lta bu'i mtsho de la swa ra swa sti zhes 'jig rten na grags te/ 'chi med mdzod kyi 'grel pa 'dod 'jor/ swa ra swa sti skad dam/ dbyangs can nam/ mtsho ldan te/ mtsho la brten pa nyid kyis yod pa'i phyir ldan pa'i rkyen phyin pa'i mtha' can no// 'di sngon tshangs pa'i 'jig rten nas tshangs pa'i mtsho la brten nas chu klung gi gzugs kyis 'jig rten 'dir babs so// zhes grags so zhes 'byung ba yin la/ ngang pa'i bu mo zhes pa yang 'grel pa de nyid las/ gan+dhar+pa dri za dang*/ gān+dhar+bha lha'i glu mkhan du 'gyur/ zhes ra bha sas dang po ring bar yang bshad do// sogs pa'i sgras sna tshogs dbyig dang*/

ba lang 'tshe dang*/ dga' byed dang*/ sna tshogs shing rta dang*/ snod can dang*/ mi sbyin dang*/ ngang pa zhes pa lta bu la sogs pa rnams so// zhes ngang pa dri za'i ming gi rnam grangs su bshad cing*/ dpal mo 'di nyid gzhan du dri za'i bu mor yang grags la/ dri za tum+bu ru'i chung ma'i tshul 'dzin pas lho phyogs rgya mtsho'i 'gram na gnas pa la phyi nang gnyis ka'i 'dod lhar byed ces kyang thos te/ bram ze phur bus kyang*/ biṣ+ṇu'i gzugs brnyan tum+bu ru la dga' skyed tshul 'dzin ma// rjes su chags bcas rol pa'i lo ni brgyad gnyis lon pa'i nyams// chu gter 'gram ngos dbu ba'i 'phreng bar rtse bar dga' ba can// dri za'i rgyal pos mngon bstod nyid kyi rnam thar phul byung rnams// zhes 'byung ba'i ngang pa ste dri za'i bu mo dbyangs can ma dang*/ 'dab chags ngang pa'i bu mo dngos gnyis sgra sbyar/ kun nas sam thams cad dkar ba ni/ lung las/ lha mo dbyangs can thams cad dkar ba pad+ma dkar po yi// dbus su bzhugs pa smra mkhas 'dod pa rnams kyis bsgom par bya// zhes pa rig byed rang lugs su sku mdog dkar ba bzhin nam/ yang na dbyangs can ma mi shes pa'i dri ma dang bral zhing*/ yon tan thams cad kyis dkar ba bzhin ngag gi 'dod pa 'jo ba dang*/ ngang mo kha dog dkar zhing mgrin pa'i dbyangs snyan dang ldan pa sbyar ba grub/ gang du rol zhe na/ mā na se zhes pa yid dang mtsho gnyis la 'jug pas lha mo yid dang ngang mo mtsho la'o zhes sgra sbyar/ su zhig gi yid la zhe na/ kho bo ste dbyug pa can bdag gi yid la'o// ci ltar zhe na/ skad cig tsam ma yin par ring du ste 'dod pa'i dngos po ma grub kyi bar du'o// de yid la rol pas ci zhig bya zhe na/ de'i mthus shes rab phun sum tshogs par 'gyur ba'i bstan bcos rtsom pa'i spobs pa bde blag tu rnyed par bshad pa sogs kyis mtshon phyi nang gi grub pa'i mtha' so sor lo rgyus dang sgrub pa'i thabs tshul mi 'dra ba du ma yod pa las/

da lam 'dir skabs su babs pa ni/ bya rgyud pad+ma'i rigs kyi pho nya mo/ sogs 'og nas 'byung ba bzhin nam/ bsdu na/ 'phags pa spyan ras gzigs dbang phyug gis snyigs ma lnga dang ldan pa'i 'gro ba rnams phyi rol pa'i lha'i gzugs dang rtags dang mtshan mas 'dul bar dgongs nas/ lha thams cad mkhyen pa zhes bya ba'i ting nge 'dzin la snyoms par zhugs nas dbang phyug sogs phyi rol pa'i lha rnams sku'i cha shas nas byung ba'i skabs/ dbyangs can ma mche ba las phyung bar bshad cing*/ nges pa'i don du dus gsum rgyal ba kun gyi yum gcig pur yin la/ de la yang rigs mang du yod pa'i nang nas shes rab skyed pa'i lhag pa'i lha bya rgyud pad+ma'i rigs kyi pho nya mo ngag dbang lha mo dbyangs can ma dkar mo'i gdams pa paṇ+ḍi ta chen po sa man+ta shrīs rgya gar nub phyogs kyi paṇ+ḍi ta shrī dz+nyā na bha dra la gnang nas lo tsā ba chen po rin chen rnam rgyal la bka' babs pa'i rjes su gnang ba zab mo sgrub par byed pa la gnyis las/ dang po slob dpon gyis bgyi bar 'os pa rnams grub nas/ gnyis pa slob ma'i bya ba la maṇ+ḍal phul/ gsol 'debs/ dus gsum sangs rgyas sogs dang*/ rgyun bshags/ dkon mchog gsum la sogs kyis kha bskangs pa rnams rjes gnang gi sngon 'gro yin/ dngos gzhi la thog mar sku'i rjes su gnang ba'i slad du dmigs pa 'di bzhin mdzod/ slob dpon gyi thugs ka nas 'od zer 'phros/ khyed rang gi lus la phog pas sdig sgrib sbyangs nas/ de la dmigs te/ oṃ swa bhā wa sogs nas/ ma lus sel ba'i nus pa dang ldan pa'i sku can du gyur pa yin snyam du mos nas/ slob dpon gyis khyed rnams kyi stan byin gyis brlab pa'i slad du/ slob dpon gyi lag pa g.yas pa'i mthe bos mthe'u chung mnan/ lhag ma gsum bsgreng ba rdo rje rtse gsum pa'i phyag rgyas khyed rang rnams kyi stan la reg nas/ oṃ ā dha ra shak+ti ka ma la ā sa na dā na daḥ

ces pas stan byin gyis brlab/ de nas khyed rang rnams kyis sngags 'di rnams kyi sgo nas gsol ba 'debs pa 'di'i rjes zlos mdzod/ oṃ ad+guṣ+ṭhā ya na maḥ oṃ tardza n+yai na maḥ oṃ mā dh+ya mā ye na maḥ oṃ a nā mi kā ye na maḥ oṃ ka niṣ+ṭha kā ye na maḥ oṃ kār+ya ka bṛṣ+ṭi bh+yo na maḥ oṃ swa ra swa sti me tiṣ+ṭha ku ru hūm̐/ lha mo dbyangs can ma bdag la zhugs la brtan par bzhugs shig ces lan gcig gsol ba btab pas slob dpon dang dbyer mi phyed pa'i lha mo las/ lha mo gnyis pa mar me gnyis mched kyi tshul du byung*/ mtsho la kha ba babs pa ltar khyed rang rnams la gnyis su med par thim pas/ lha mo'i sku dang khyed rang rnams kyi lus dbyer mi phyed par gyur pa'i mos pa mdzod byas la/ de brtan par bya ba'i phyir slob dpon gyis slob ma'i spyi bor me tog dkar po bzhag la/ lha mo 'di la stsal lags kyi// lha mo 'di la byin gyis rlobs// slob mas kyang slob dpon la drin lan gyi tshul du me tog 'thor bzhin pa dang bcas pas/ lha mo bdag la stsal lags kyi// bdag la 'go bar mdzad du gsol// zhes brjod do// de nas slob dpon gyis sngar gyi rdo rje rtse gsum pa'i phyag rgya slob ma'i snying gar reg la/ oṃ hṛ da yā ya tiṣ+ṭha/ gtsug tor du reg la/ oṃ shi ra si swā hā/ spyi bor reg la/ oṃ shi khā yai bau ṣaṭ/ nam tshos su reg la/ oṃ ka ba tsā ya hūm̐/ mig gnyis su reg la/ oṃ nai tra yā ya boṣaṭ/ lag pa gnyis la reg la/ oṃ hastā ya phaṭ/ ces brtan par byin gyis brlabs pa'i mos pa mdzod/ sku'i rjes gnang ngo*// de nas gsung gi rjes gnang gi slad du slob dpon dang lha mo gnyis su med pa'i thugs ka'i 'khor lo las hrīṃḥyig gi phreng ba zhal nas byung ste de las 'od zer dkar po phyogs bcur 'phros/ zhes sogs nas/ ldan par gyur pa'i mos pa mdzad nas/

slob dpon gyi phreng ba nas bzung la sngags 'di'i rjes zlos lan brgya rtsa brgyad mdzod/ hrīṃḥzhes dang*/ yang 'di'i rjes zlos kyang lan nyer gcig gam bdun mdzod/ zhes gang rung brjod la/ hrīṃḥ.a ā/ sogs nas aṃ aḥbar brjod/ de nas phreng ba slob ma'i mgo bor bzhag la/ 'di'i rjes zlos mdzod/ oṃ hrīṃḥwa ra wāk wā dī na maḥ tshar re/ gsung gi rjes gnang ngo*// de nas sngar gyi mar me'i sdong bu rnams spar la/ thugs kyi rjes gnang gi slad du/ slob dpon dang lha mo gnyis su med pa'i thugs ka'i yi ge las/ yi ge rang 'dra'i rnam pa rin po che'i sgron me bstar la brgyus pa lta bu byung*/ de dag las 'od zer dkar po phyogs bcur 'phros pas/ zhes sogs nas/ yig 'bru dang bcas pa la thim pas lha mo'i thugs dang rang sems dbyer med du gyur pas/ phyi nang gi mun pa rnams bsal/ shes bya thams cad la blo gros thogs pa med par rgyas shing nus mthu dang gzi brjid phun sum tshogs pa dang ldan par gyur pa'i mos pa mdzad nas/ mar me rnams yi ge'i ngo bor bsgoms nas bzhes par zhu/ zhes dang*/ hrīṃḥ.a ā sogs brjod cing byin la/ de brtan par bya ba'i phyir du sngags 'di'i rjes zlos lan gsum mdzod/ oṃ swa ra swa sti me hṛ da yo tiṣ+ṭha hrīṃḥ.a ā nas/ aḥzhes lan gsum bzlas pas brtan par byas pa'i mos pa mdzod/ thugs kyi rjes gnang ngo*// de rnams kyi sgo nas rjes gnang zab mo legs par gsan pa yin pas gnas skabs de dag tu thob pa'i sogs dam tshig bsdus te khas blang*/ yon gyi maṇ+ḍal/ deng nas sogs spyi 'gre/ des rgya gar gyi paṇ+ḍi ta chen po sa man+ta shrī nas nye bar brgyud de zhwa lu'i thugs sras lo tsā ba chen po rin chen rnam rgyal la bka' babs pa'i sgra dbyangs lha mo dbyangs can ma'i rjes gnang zab mo gsan pa yin pas sogs brjod la/ bsod nams 'di yis sogs spyi 'gre/

slob ma rang gnas su btang*/ gsum pa ni/ mchod bstod gshegs gsol sogs thar rtse paṇa chen gyi yi ger gsungs kyang*/ gong du lha mo rang la thim zhing mar me slob mas zos tshar ba'i lhag ma yig 'bru lha'i rang bzhin tu gnas pa la yin na ma gtogs/ rang lha mor gsal ba la mchod bstod bzod gsol bya/ gnas gsum bsrung*/ bsngo smon shis brjod yin nam snyam yang gang yin mkhas pa rnams kyis dpyad par zhu/ zhes sa skya pa kun blos thugs sras rin po che dang*/ thar rtse paṇa chen gyi yig cha gung bsgrigs te chos 'di'i bka' mi nub par bya ba'i lhag bsam kho nas las dang po rnams la phan pa'i phyir bris pa'o// sarba dā maṅga laṃ// ༈ /dbyangs can ma dkar mo'i rjes gnang gi brgyud 'debs byin rlabs gter mdzod bzhugs so// na mo gu ru bh+yaḥ blo gros snang ba'i gter mdzod dbyangs can ma// gang des rjes bzung sa man+ta shrī// mkhas pa chen po ye shes bzang po dang*// rin chen rnam rgyal rnams la gsol ba 'debs// nam mkha' chos rgyal mkhas pa tsan+d+ra shrī// mkhyen rab rje dang lo chen chos skyong bzang*// sa lo 'jam rdor ngor chen dkon lhun zhabs// shes rab rgyal mtshan rnams la gsol ba 'debs// nam mkha' dpal bzang mchog legs rdo rje dang*// bstan 'dzin bzang po mkhyen rab byams pa'i dpal// mkhyen brtse rab brtan rmor chen rdo rje 'chang*// gnas gsar chos rje rnams la gsol ba 'debs// 'jam dbyangs gos dkar rnam rol kun blo'i zhabs// khyad par lam 'di'i gdams pa stsol ba'i rje// skyabs gnas kun 'dus rtsa ba'i bla ma la// rtse gcig gus pa'i yid kyis gsol ba 'debs// lam gyi sngon 'gro skyabs sems rnam dag gis// bdag rgyud yongs bskul gnas lugs spros bral las// rang lus lha mo'i rnam par snang stong skur// gsal la 'dzin med ting 'dzin brtan par shog /grags stong hrīṃḥgi rang gdangs 'gogs med gsung*// bar med ngag gi bzlas pa skyon bral dang*// rig stong 'od zer drwa ba'i 'phro 'du yis// 'khor 'das shes rab snang ba'i dpal thob shog

/rgyal ba kun yum ngag dbang dbyangs lha mo'i// go 'phang mchog de bdag gis legs thob nas// sa gsum 'gro ba'i rgyud kyi rmongs pa yi// dri ma ma lus sel ba'i mgon gyur cig/ ༈ /dbyangs can dkar mo'i sgrub thabs nyung gsal snying por dril ba bzhugs so// na mo gu ru bh+yaḥ spros pa'i mtshan ma las grol ba'i// rgyal yum shes rab pha rol phyin// zag bral bde chen shes bya'i blo// ma lus stsol mdzad lha mor 'dud// gang de bsgrub pa'i thabs gsal ba// mang du mchis mod 'on kyang 'dir// nyung gsal snying por dril ba zhig /don gnyer re ba bskang phyir 'bri// 'dir 'phags ma dbyangs can ma bsgom par 'dod pas/ skyabs sems tshad med sogs spyi ltar byas la/ oṃ swa bhā was stong par sbyang*/ stong pa'i ngang las rab dkar chu skyes 'dab// stong ldan pad+ma'i lte bar zla shel dbus// rang nyid skad cig dran rdzogs dbyangs lha mo// dri bral shel bum lta bur dkar mdzes sku// dri med 'od kyi drwa ba'i 'phro 'du can// zhi 'dzum chags pa'i rnam 'gyur g.yo ba'i zhal// gzhan yid skul ba'i zur mig nyams kyis spud// 'jam mnyen bung ba ltar nag thor tshugs ngos// me tog dkar po'i phreng bas rnam par bkra// dbu skra'i lan bu rin chen rgyan phreng gis// rnam par mdzes pa rgyab ngos g.yo zhing 'phyang*// bai ḍūr sngon po'i 'phang 'gror phyag gis rtsen// nor bus spra ba'i gser gyi snyan cha dang*// dbu rgyan mgul rgyan do shal phyag zhabs kyi// gdu bu bkod legs 'thabs pa'i sil sgra dang*// 'od zer phan tshun 'khrugs pa'i rgyan gyis mdzes// bcu drug lang tsho'i nyams kyis dga' bde'i ro// ster ba'i 'o 'dzin mngon mtho rjes chags kyi// rnam pas mdzes sku g.yon 'gying skye 'phags kun// yid kyi brtan pa 'phrog pa'i rnam rol can// lha rdzas dar gyi stod g.yogs smad dkris ngos// sna tshogs chu skyes pad dkar chun pos mdzes// ri bong 'dzin pas spyi bo'i steng mtshan zhing*// zhabs zung tsog pu'i rol pas bzhugs pa de'i// snying nyid blo yis gyen bslangs brgyad tshal du// gyes pa'i pad dkar 'dab ma brgyad pa ni// ze'u 'bru dmar ser 'od zer rab 'phro bas// bskor ba'i lte ba'i steng na nya gang zla// dri med dbus su rang sems yi ge hrīṃḥ

/mdun nas brtsams te g.yas skor rim pa yis// 'dab brgyad ā li bcu drug zung res brgyan// yig 'bru de dag shel ltar dkar tsher zhing*// ldem bzhengs gdan la ma reg cung zad 'dar// 'khor lo'i yig 'bru'i 'od kyis lus gang bas// snying gi mun pa ma lus sangs kyis dag /'od zer snang ba sna bug g.yas nas 'thon// lho phyogs rgya mtsho'i 'gram nas mtsho byung ma// 'khor bcas skad cig spyan drangs mkha' la bzhugs// oṃ badz+ra sa mā dzaḥ zhes spyan drangs la/ oṃ swa ra swa sti sa pa ri wā ra ar+ghaṃ/ pā d+yaṃ/ āñca ma naṃ/ prok+ṣa ṇaṃ/ puṣ+pe sogs nas/ shab+da tīts+tsha swā hā/ bar gyis mchod/ oṃ swa ra swa sti me hṛ da la tiṣ+ṭha hrīṃḥ zhes pas gnyis su med par thim par bsam/ de nas bzlas pa ni/ thugs ka'i hrīṃḥlas rang 'dra mu tig gi /phreng ba lta bu legs byung zhal nas 'thon// lte bar zhugs te thugs ka'i hrīṃḥl thim// de lta'i sngags phreng las 'phros 'od dkar po'i// 'phro 'dus phyogs bcu'i zhing khyab skye 'phags sogs// bcud dang snod kyi shes rab spobs pa gzungs// mkhyen brtse nus mthu gzi byin tshe bsod rgyas// khab len rdo yis lcags phye bsdus pa bzhin// tshur 'dus rang gi khar zhugs snying ga yi// 'khor lo yig 'bru bcas la thim pa'i mthus// blo gros thogs med shes bya'i rtsal rdzogs shing*// gzi brjid nus mthu phun tshogs ldan par gyur// ces brjod cing bsams la/ ngag tu hrīṃḥbargya rtsa sogs ci nus dang*/ hrīṃḥ a ā sogs ā li bdun nam nyer gcig bzla'o// sgra dbyangs lha mo dbyangs can mas// bdag sogs sems can thams cad la// bdag med rtogs pa'i shes rab kyi// snang ba dam pa stsal du gsol// ces smon lam bya/ de ltar paṇ+ḍi ta sa man+ta shrī nas brgyud pa'i dbyangs can dkar mo'i rjes gnang gi brgyud 'debs dang sgrub thabs nyung bsdus 'di lta bu zhig dgos zhes/

rang gi slob ma'i mchog dge slong byams pa phrin las yon tan gyis lha rdzas rin chen gnyis pa'i skyes bcas bskul ngor/ rje btsun bla ma rnams kyi bran du gyur pa gzim 'og sprul sku byams pa ngag dbang bstan 'dzin phrin las kyis sbyar ba'o// yi ge pa ni skul ba po nyid do// ༈ /dus gsum rgyal ba'i yum gcig dbyangs can lha mo'i bstod pa rmongs pa'i mun pa 'phrog byed ces bya ba bzhugs so// swa sti/ dus gsum sras bcas rgyal ba'i mkhyen brtse'i tshogs// srid zhi'i mtshar sdug rdzogs par shar ba'i dpyid// bcu drug dga' bas rab dregs dbyangs lha mo// dran pas rmongs mun 'phrog byed gang der 'dud// ljon pa'i rgyal po 'dzam bus bkra ba'i gling*// bkod legs lta na sdug pa'i lho yi phyogs// bai ḍūr mthing zhun 'khyil ba'i rgya mtsho'i 'gram// yid 'phrog dbyangs can dga' ba'i skyed tshal na// lha klu dri za mi'am ci'i bu mo// mdzes sdug mig gi bdud rtsir gyur pa'i tshogs// rtsed 'jo'i 'phrul brgya g.yo ba'i lding khang der// bde sogs bdag po'i gzhu ris 'khrugs pa'i dbus// in+d+ra nī la'i rlabs phreng bye phrag brgya// mu tig zegs ma 'thor ba'i lbu ba dang*// chab gcig bskyod las srid zhi'i snyan 'gyur kun// 'khrol ba'i ngo mtshar tshangs pa 'du rdzing na// mnyen lcug 'khrel ldem 'dab brgya rgyas pa'i steng*// bdud rtsi'i zer brgya 'dzag pa'i zla shel dbus// rgyal kun mkhyen brtse'i ye shes hrīṃḥgyi gzugs// 'jam mgon dgyes mdzad rdo rje dbyangs lha mo// kun gsal khong na shar ba'i mtshar sdug kun// ji snyed gcig tu bsdus kyang gang gi skur// 'gran bral dkar 'jam mu tig gsar pa'i 'od// 'tsher ba'i snang brnyan 'jo sgeg 'phrul bag 'chang*// zag med bde ba chen po'i ye shes re// ster ba'i 'o 'dzin zla ba spungs 'dra zung*// chags bral rgyal rnams rjes chags dga' bzhi la// skul ba'i pho nya ched du ngoms min nam// zhi zhing 'dzum la chags pa'i rnam 'gyur kun// gcig car rdzogs pa'i bzhin ras ston dus kyi// g.ya' bral zla ba'i me long dwangs pa'i ngos// smin ma'i ri dwags mtshan ma mchog tu bkra// shel gyi ljon shing gsar pa'i yal ga dang*// mtshungs pa'i phyag zung bai ḍūr rgyud mangs la// rtsen pa'i sgra dang shes bya'i chos kun glur// sgrogs pa'i dbyangs snyan skal bzang rna ba'i dpyid// kha ba'i rdul brtsegs dbang po'i gzhu ris kyis// 'khyud 'dra'i pañca li kā'i lha yi gos// lhab lhub g.yo ba'i na bza'i srab 'jam dar// snang stong sku yi ngos su ma 'dres gsal// rnam bkra nor bu'i gtsug rgyan do shal dang*// phyag zhabs gdu bu 'thabs pa'i sil sil sgra// nyams 'gyur stong gis spud 'di gti mug gnyid// slong ba'i ngo mtshar rol mo ched du byas// mtha' yas shes byar srid kun gzhom bral gsung*// snyan 'gyur dri za'i gling bus bskrun min pa'i// drug cu'i yan lag dang ldan tshangs dbyangs glur// rtag par 'bab pa'i dge mtshan 'di rmad byung*// ji lta ji snyed srid zhi'i chos kun glur// 'gogs med sa ler 'chang ba mkhyen pa'i mtsho// mtha' yas yon tan nor bus yongs gang ba// spros bral chos dbyings ye shes chen por grub// de ltar gsang gsum zad mi shes pa'i mdzod// blo 'das yon tan rdzogs pa'i 'khor lo che// dran pas srid zhi'i rgud pa spyi bye brag

/khyad par stug po'i ma rig dbyings zhir mdzod// chos dang chos min dbye ba'i rnam dpyod rtsal// rab thob 'chad rtsod rtsom pa'i g.yu ral bkra// phas rgol 'joms nus rig pa'i mtsho rnon can// dpal ldan mi yi seṅger bdag gyur cig /skye dang skye ba kun tu srid pa der// rigs gzugs dpal 'byor phun tshogs dam chos la// spyod pa'i skal bzang dang ldan bcu phrag gi 'khrul bral rig lam dka' ba med spyod shog /snyigs dus thub bstan rin chen shing rta'i srog /chags gzhi tshul gnas khrims dang 'chad nyan rgyun// phra ba'i lam srol 'di dag lus srog dang*// bsdos te ring por sring ba'i nus ldan shog /khyad par srid lam ring por dub pa'i ma// kun gsal lto ba khengs pa'i 'gro 'di dag /zhi ba bla med rdzogs pa'i byang chub la// thabs mkhas thugs rjes dkri ba'i nus ldan shog /bdag kyang ring min chos dbyings spros bral zhal// mjal ba'i skal bzang dang 'grogs dbyangs can lha// dga' mar thob pa'i 'jam dbyangs mgon po de'i// thugs gsang 'khor lo'i dbyings su thim gyur cig /rgyal yum rdo rje dbyangs can mar bstod pa rmongs pa'i mun pa 'phrog byed ces bya ba 'di ni/ rmongs brtul snyom las mkhan gzim 'og sprul sku byams pa ngag dbang bstan 'dzin phrin las kyis rang gi dad pa'i gsos su bris pa dge bar gyur cig/ ༈ /gong gi brgyud 'debs kyi kha skong ni/ 'jam dbyangs gos dkar rnam rol kun blo'i zhabs// ces pa'i mtshams su/ thams cad mkhyen pa bstan 'dzin phrin las dang*// ngag gi dbang po phrin las yon tan zhabs// rtsa ba'i bla ma

byams pa ngag dbang bstan 'dzin snyan grags/ rnams la gsol ba 'debs// yang na/ 'jam dbyangs gos dkar rnam rol kun blo'i zhabs/ bar 'dir bla ma gzhan dgos sam cung zad dpyad/ /mkhas grub chen po nam mkha' 'chi med dang*// skyabs gnas kun 'dus kun dga' bstan 'dzin la// rtse gcig gus pa'i yid kyis gsol ba 'debs// yang na/ shes rab rgyal mtshan rnams la gsol ba 'debs// zhes pa'i mtshams/ nam mkha' dpal bzang kun dga' bkra shis dang*// shes rab 'byung gnas mkhan chen zhwa lu pa// blo bzang rgya mtsho thugs sras 'jam dbyangs grags// bde ba'i rdo rje rnams la gsol ba 'debs// bstan pa'i rgyal stag phu ba/ mtshan kun mkhyen 'jigs 'jam dbyangs bzhad pa/ med dbang*// 'jam dpal dbyangs dngos bstan pa'i sgron gung thang rin po che/ me dang*// bka' drin mnyam med dkon mchog kun 'dus dngos// bstan pa rab rgyas rnams la gsol ba 'debs// zhes gang mos sbyar ba'i mthar lam gyi sngon 'gro sogs sbrel lo// zhes pa'ang rje btsun bla ma dam pa rnam pa gsum las chos tshul 'di'i bka' drin nos pa shākya'i dge slong 'jam dbyangs mkhyen brtse'i dbang pos sbyar ba shu bhaṃ/ sarba dā maṅga laṃ// ༈ /mkhas pa chen po sa man+ta shrī nas brgyud pa'i dbyangs can ma dkar mo'i bsnyen sgrub las gsum gyi rnam gzhag blo gros sgo brgya 'byed pa'i lde'u mig ces bya ba bzhugs so// oṃ swa sti/ mtshan rtog spros pa'i 'du 'god rnams dang gzhar yang mi mdza' ye shes che// mchog tu mi 'gyur zag pa med pa'i bde ba chen po dang 'grogs nas// srid zhi'i mun pa drungs nas 'byin la zla shel bdud rtsis mtshon min la// dpal ldan bla ma mchog dang dbyer med sgra dbyangs lha mor phyag bgyi'o// gang zhig mkhas pa'i chu gter dar babs shing*// grub gnyis rin chen bye bas mngon gtams pa'i// sngon byon 'dren mchog brgyud par bcas rnams la// mi phyed gus pa'i lag pad snying gar zum// 'di na sgra dbyangs lha mo la brten nas// blo gros sgo brgya 'byed par byed pa'i thabs// legs bshad nor bu'i lde'u mig yid 'ong ba// rmongs pa'i gdung ba sel ba'i ched du sbyin// de la 'dir mtha' med pa'i 'khor ba sdug bsngal gyi rgya mtsho chen po las thar bar 'dod pa'i skyes bu blo gros dang ldan pa rnams kyis spang bya'i gtso bo ni/

'khor bar 'khyams pa'i rgyu ma rig pa dang mtshungs par ldan pa'i bdag tu 'dzin pa nyid yin la/ de'i gnyen por gyur pa ni/ de dang 'dzin stangs dngos su 'gal ba'i bdag med rtogs pa'i shes rab kho na la ltos dgos te/ slob dpon chen po zhi ba lhas/ yan lag 'di dag thams cad ni// thub pas shes rab don du gsungs// de yi phyir na sdug bsngal dag /zhi bar 'dod pas shes rab bskyed// ces gsungs pa ltar ro// des na de lta bu'i shes rab kyi nyer len tsam rang gi steng nas grub pa zhig yin kyang*/ de sad par byed pa'i lhan cig byed rkyen ni lhag pa'i lha khyad par can re la nges par brten dgos/ de la'ang rgyud sde rin po che rnams las shes rab kyi lha bsam las 'das pa zhig gsungs kyang*/ rgya bod kyi mkhas grub kun la nyi zla ltar grags pa ni rje btsun 'jam pa'i dbyangs dang*/ lha mo dbyangs can ma kho na yin la/ phyi ma ni nges pa'i don du dus gsum gyi rgyal ba sras dang bcas pa rnams kyi yum shes rab kyi pha rol tu phyin ma nyid yin kyang*/ snang tshul du 'phags pa 'jig rten dbang phyug gi zhal gyi mche ba'i myu gu las 'khrungs shing*/ phyi rol mu stegs byed dang*/ nang pa sangs rgyas kyi bstan la zhugs pa thams cad kyis yi dam du 'dzin pas thugs rje ris med du 'jug cing*/ byin rlabs shin tu che bar grags pa'i 'phags ma ngag gi dbang phyug dbyangs can ma dkar mo'i gdams pa 'di 'chad pa la don gnyis te/ gang las byung ba'i lo rgyus dang*/ de las byung ba'i gdams pa dngos bshad pa'o// dang po la gnyis/ bshad bya chos kyi lo rgyus dang*/ bla ma brgyud pa'i lo rgyus so// dang po ni/ bdag cag gi ston pa yang dag par rdzogs pa'i sangs rgyas thabs mkhas la thugs rje chen po dang ldan pa de nyid kyis gdul bya rnams kyi khams dang*/ bsam pa dang*/ bag la nyal dang rjes su mthun par chos kyi bdud rtsi'i sgo 'phar bsam gyis mi khyab pa zhig phye ba rnams kyi nang nas rab dang*/

mchog dang*/ phul du gyur pa ni rig pa 'dzin pa sngags kyi sde snod yin la/ de la'ang grub pa'i slob dpon so sos dbye bsdu mi 'dra ba du ma zhig mdzad kyang rje btsun sa skya pa yab sras rnams kyi bzhed pas gtso bor rgyud sde bzhir grangs nges par mdzad cing*/ de lta bu'i rgyud sde rin po che rnams las zhi rgyas dbang drag dang rjes su 'brel ba'i yi dam gyi lha bsam gyis mi khyab pa zhig gsungs pa las/ 'dir shes rab rgyas par byed pa dbyangs can ma dkar mo'i skor yin/ 'di sngon byon pa'i dam pa rnams kyis bya rgyud pad+ma'i rigs kyi pho nya mo'i khongs su gtogs par bzhed cing*/ spyir theg pa chen po'i mdo sde gser 'od dam pa dang*/ dkon mchog tā la/ za ma tog bkod pa'i mdo/ 'jam dpal rtsa ba'i rgyud/ 'jam dpal dpa' bo gcig grub/ mkha' 'gro rgya mtsho/ rdo rje gur/ dgra nag gi rgyud sogs las 'di'i lha dang*/ sngags dang*/ mtshan la sogs pa mi 'dra ba ci rigs pa bstan to// gnyis pa ni/ de lta bu'i lhag pa'i lha khyad par can 'di nyid kyang grub pa'i slob dpon so so la bka' babs pa'i lugs srol mi 'dra ba du ma zhig yod de/ bram ze phur bu nas rim par brgyud de sum pa lo tsā bas bod du dar bar mdzad pa'i dbyangs can ma dkar mo bram ze phur bu'i lugs zhes yongs su grags pa dang*/ bo dong paṇ+ḍi ta 'jigs bral phyogs las rnam rgyal la lha mo nyid kyis zhal mngon sum du bstan pas spobs pa'i gter mdzod chen po grol te/ de nyid 'dus pa la sogs pa'i bstan bcos glegs bam brgya phrag thal ba gsung rtsom gnang ba sogs bstan pa nyin mo ltar mdzad pa de las brgyud pa'i dbyangs can ma dkar mo bo dong lugs dang*/ gshin rje gshed dgra nag po'i rgyud kyi rjes su 'brangs te kha che'i paṇ+ḍi ta chen po bik+ṣa pa ra ma sogs nas nye bar brgyud cing zhal gzigs kyi brgyud pa bar ma chad pa shin tu zab pa dbyangs can ma dmar mo gsang sgrub kyi skor dang*/

gzhan yang sgrub thabs rgya mtsho sogs nas 'byung ba'i gdams skor mang du bzhugs pa las/ 'dir skabs su babs pa ni/ sras dang bcas pa'i rgyal ba yongs kyi shes rab stong pa'i rang gzugs 'phags ma ngag gi dbang phyug ma nyid kyi ye shes kyi skus mngon sum du rjes su bzung ba mkhas shing grub pa brnyes pa'i slob dpon chen po sa man+ta shrī zhes yongs su grags pa des rgya gar nub phyogs kyi paṇ+ḍi ta shrī dz+nyā na bha dra mu nīn+d+ra la gnang*/ de nyid chen po hor gyis gdan drangs te bod du byon nas zhwa lu tshong dus su phebs pa na/ rtsod pa'i dus kyi thams cad mkhyen pa bu ston rin po ches thugs sras lo tsā ba rin chen rnam rgyal spyan 'dren pa la ched du gtang nas mngags kyang*/ hor gyis bkag nas phebs ma thub/ de'i tshe bu ston rin po ches slar yang thugs sras lo tsā ba la sgra tshad dang rgyud sde'i skor gyi dri ba 'ga' dang bcas te gdams pa zab mo 'dra 'dug na'ang nyon shog ces bsgos nas mngags/ thugs sras lo tsā bas kyang dogs pa gcod pa'i dri ba thams cad mthil phyin par mdzad cing*/ khyad par du dbyangs can ma'i sgrub skor 'di nyid kyi rjes gnang man ngag dang bcas pa gsan te/ zhag nyer gcig tsam bsgrubs pas pi waṃ gi sgra dngos su gsan nas mkhyen rab kyi klong brdol/ gzhan yang phyis su tshar chen chos kyi rgyal pos zhag bdun sgrub pa mdzad pas me tog dkar po'i char babs shing dngos su zhal gzigs pas snyan ngag rtsom pa la thogs med du gyur/ rgyal ba dge 'dun rgya mtshos bsgrubs pas kyang zhal dngos su bstan nas ja sbyor re'i yun la sh+lo ka brgya re tsam zin pa'i thugs rab phun sum tshogs pa byung zhing*/ rgya gar gyi chu bo gaṅgā tshun chad la 'gran zla spangs pa'i snyan ngag mkhan chen por grags pa sogs rang gzhan gyi bla ma gong ma thams cad kyis thugs nyams su bzhes shing*/

grub pa brnyes pa sha stag byung bas byin rlabs kyi tshan kha shin tu che ba yin no// gnyis pa de las byung ba'i gdams pa dngos bshad pa la gsum/ thog mar lha nye bar bsnyen pa'i cho ga bar du dngos grub ji ltar sgrub pa'i tshul/ tha ma las sbyor gyi sgo nas rang gzhan la phan gdags pa'o// dang po la lnga/ gang gis sgom pa'i rten gyi gang zag gang du nyams su len pa'i gnas/ dus nam gyi tshe bya ba/ tshul ji lta bu'i sgo nas nyams su len pa/ de ltar nyams su blangs pa'i 'bras bu bstan pa'o// dang po ni/ 'khor ba las thar 'dod kyi blo bcos ma ma yin pa dang ldan zhing*/ tshangs spyod kyi bslab pa la gnas pa/ sems can thams cad pha mar shes shing drin dran pa'i sgo nas/ de rnams byang chub la dgod par 'dod pa'i blo khyad par can dang ldan pa/ lhag par 'di'i rjes gnang lung la sogs pa legs par thob cing*/ bla ma dang dkon mchog la mi phyed pa'i dad pa dang ldan pa khrus dang gtsang sbra la gtso bor gnas pa zhig nges par dgos pa yin te/ bram ze phur bus mdzad pa'i stod pa las/ lha mo gtsang sbra la dga' rdzun spangs 'byung po'i zas dor zhing*// tshangs spyod brtul zhugs can gyis nyin rer dran byas yum bos na// zhes sogs gsungs shing*/ de bzhin du gzhan las kyang bshad do// gnyis pa ni/ mdo sde rgyan las/ blo ldan gang du sgrub pa'i yul// zhes sogs gsungs pa ltar gyi mtshan nyid dang ldan zhing*/ lhag par sgrub skor tshigs bcad ma las/ bud med bral ba'i sa phyogs su// gtsang sbrar gnas pa shin tu gces// zhes pa ltar bud med kyi rgyu 'grul sogs med pa'i gnas dben zhing nyams dga' bar rang gi stan bshams pa'i sngas mgor sga la sogs pa mi 'jog cing gtsang bar bya'o// gsum pa ni/ zla ba gang yang rung ba'i yar gyi ngo'i tshes grangs dang gza' skar sbyor byed bzang po 'dzom pa'i dus su'o// bzhi pa ni/ dkon mchog gi rten gyi mdun du gtor ma bshams pa sogs dngos gzhir dgos pa'i yo byad thams cad 'du byas la/

cha gsum btang ba sogs sbyor ba'i chos rnams mkhan chen sangs rgyas phun tshogs kyis mdzad pa'i bsnyen yig cha 'di nyid dmigs bsal ma rnyed na bsnyen yig spyi 'gro ltar byas pas kyang rung ngo*// yig ltar byas pas don 'grub pa yod do// dngos gzhi la/ bsam gtan gyi spyod lam dang ldan pas 'dug ste/ thog mar khams gsum gyi 'khor ba mtha' dag sdug bsngal gyi rang bzhin me 'obs lta bur rtogs par byas nas/ de las rang gzhan rnams thar bar 'dod pa'i kun slong rnam par dag pa dang ldan pas/ ngag tu brgyud pa'i gsol 'debs sngon tu 'gro bas skyabs yul rnams gsal gdab la/ skyabs su 'gro ba'i tshig brjod pa nas bzung bzlas pa'i bar thar rtse paṇa chen gyis mdzad pa'i yig cha'am/ gzim 'og sprul sku bstan 'dzin phrin las kyis mdzad pa'i sgrub thabs tshigs bcad ma sogs dam pa gong ma tshad ldan gyis mdzad pa'i yig cha gang mos ltar bya/ bzlas pa'i sngon du nor bu rgyas pa'i gzhal med khang gi gzungs las 'byung ba'i phreng sngags/ oṃ ru tsi ra ma ṇi pra war+dha nā ya swā hā/ zhes pa'i sngags 'dis phreng ba la btab kyang phun sum tshogs pa'i yan lag tu 'gyur la/ ma byas kyang chad pa'i skyon ni med do// de nas las mthun gyi phreng ba'am med kyang las thams cad la bsngags pa bo dhi rtsi'i phreng ba bzung la/ hrīṃḥzhes pa mi tshig gis bar ma chod cing*/ myur ba la sogs pa'i skyon dang bral pa'i sgo nas ji tsam nus kyi bar bzlas la mthar/ hrīṃḥ.a ā sogs bdun nam nyer gcig bzla/ de'ang rnam rtog rgya 'byams su btang nas bzlas brjod sogs byed pa ni byas la ma bsags pa'i las yin pas spang dgos te/ spyod 'jug las/ bzlas brjod dang ni dka' thub sogs// yun ring dus su spyad byas kyang*// sems gzhan g.yeng bas byas pa ni// de nyid rig pas don med gsungs// zhes pa ltar ro// des na sems bying ba dang rgod pa las rgyab kyis phyogs te/

dmigs pa la rtse gcig tu mnyam par 'jog dgos/ de yang sgrub thabs nas bshad pa'i dmigs pa gcig kho nas skyo na/ res lha yi sku snang la rang bzhin med pa la sems bzung*/ res sngags kyi sgra la yid gtad/ res thugs ka'i 'khor lo yig 'bru dang bcas pa la sems 'dzin/ res sems kyi gnas lugs brjod bral gyi ngang du ngal bso ba sogs mdor na tha mal gyi rnam par rtog pa'i gzhan dbang du ma song bar ci nas kyang bya/ gzhan yang legs grub kyi rgyud las/ mkhas pas rig sngags zlos ba'i tshe// sbrid pa lu ba sogs byung na// nye reg byas nas phyag 'tshal te// gzhi nas kun tu brtsi bar bya// bzlas brjod kyi ni gegs rnams dang*// mkhas pas bzlas brjod skyon rnams la// slar yang grangs kyi thog ma nas// kun tu brtsam par bya bar bshad// ces sogs gsungs pa rnams kyang snying gi bum par bcang ba gal che zhing*/ 'di'i sgrub thabs rnams tshig tshogs nyung bas nges par thun bzhir bya/ thun mjug tu 'dod don gsol ba btab la dge ba bsngo/ rjes gtor ma 'bul ba ni/ snga thun gyi mjug tu mkhan chen pa'i bsnyen yig las ji ltar 'byung ba bzhin phul/ thun mtshams rnams su 'phags ma'i yon tan dran bzhin pa'i sgo nas/ tshig don phun sum tshogs pa'i bstod pa ci rigs pas bstod/ skabs 'gar bar chad srung ba'i phyir khro bo gang yang rung ba'i sngags cung zad bzla/ gzhan yang dpung bzang las/ bzlas pas skyo na mdo sde bklag par bya// gtsang zhing dben pa'i sa phyogs rnams su ni// 'jim pa'am ni bye ma las byas pa'i// bde gshegs mchod rten rten 'brel snying po can// sdig pa sbyong ba'i phyir ni rtag tu gdab// ces dang*/ bzlas brjod zin nas cung zad smra bar bya// smra nas lud pa bshang gci dor nas kyang*// chu yi nang du zhugs nas khrus kyang bya// me tog dri snod mar me phul ba dang*// tshul khrims brtson 'grus dka' thub byas pa yi// dge ba de kun bla na med pa yi// sangs rgyas byang chub bla med mchog tu bsngo// zhes sogs rgya cher bka' stsal pa rnams kyang shes yams tsam du ma song bar lag len du thebs dgos shing*/

'di'i grangs bsnyen ni thugs sras pa'i yig char/ hrīṃḥzhes pa 'bum phrag lnga bsnyen par bya'o// zhes 'byung bas yi ge gcig pa 'bum phrag lnga/ kha skong khri tsho lnga bcas bzla dgos pa yin la/ de ltar bzlas pas 'og nas bshad pa'i rtags rnams ci rigs pa 'byung bar 'gyur ro// de yang grangs ma tshang bar rtags byung na'ang*/ grangs nyid tshang bar bya dgos/ gal te rtags ma byung na bsnyen pa lan gsum mam bdun du spogs pas 'byung bar 'gyur ro// lnga pa de ltar nyams su blangs pa'i 'bras bu la gnyis/ gnas skabs dang*/ mthar thug go /dang po ni/ dngos su sngar bas dran pa gsal zhing lce bde ba dang*/ gzhung mang du 'dzin pa dang*/ 'chad rtsod rtsom gsum la thogs pa med pa'i blo gros kyi 'jug pa rgyas pa sogs 'byung la/ rmi lam du bud med gzhon nu ma gos dkar po gyon pas dkar gsum gyi zas ster ba zos pa/ shel dang*/ thod le kor dang*/ me tog gi phreng ba gtod pa/ nam langs pa/ nyi zla shar ba/ chu gtsang ma'i rgyun 'thung zhing khrus byed pa/ me tog gi tshal na rtse ba/ 'ja' 'od kyi gur khyim phub pa/ bya dang ri dwags sogs sngon ma mthong ba rmis pa/ nam mkha' la 'phur ba/ zhing rmo ba/ snag tsha 'thung ba/ ri mthon po'i rtse la phyin pa/ chu bo las brgal ba/ mtshon cha dang*/ pi waṃ dang*/ me long rnyed pa sogs rmis pa ni shes rab 'phel ba'i rtags so// gnyis pa ni/ de lta bu'i mtshan ma rnyed nas kyang 'og tu bshad pa'i dngos grub sgrub pa la sogs pa rnams la 'bad pa chen po'i sgo nas nyams su blangs na/ re zhig nas bdag med rtogs pa'i shes rab kyi snang ba ches cher rgyas te/ 'khor bar 'khyams pa'i rtsa ba ma rig pa la sogs pa'i 'khri shing thams cad rnam par bsregs shing*/ de dag la brten nas mi ring bar 'khor ba'i rgya mtsho'ang skem par 'gyur ba ni nges pa'o// spyi don gnyis pa bar du dngos grub ji ltar sgrub ba'i cho ga la'ang*/

sbyor ba/ dngos gzhi/ rjes gsum las/ dang po sbyor ba ni/ de ltar bsnyen pa sngon du song ba'i rnal 'byor pas/ mdun du stegs bu ji ltar rigs pa'i steng du/ rin po che'am/ shing ngam/ rdo la sogs pa'i maṇ+ḍal chu gtsang gis dag par bkru/ rlan ma yal bar dri bzang gi phye ma bkram/ de'i steng du gser gyi thur mas/ pad+ma 'dab ma brgyad pa'i lte bar zla ba'i dkyil 'khor/ de'i dbus su hrīṃḥ 'dab ma rnams la mdun nas g.yas skor du/ a ā nas/ aṃ aḥ'i bar 'dab ma re la yig 'bru zung re bris pa la ba mar dang sbrang rtsi sbyar ba'am/ ba yi 'o ma sogs gang rung gis bris la 'bras dkar gyi phye mas ri mo'i steng nas mnan pa mañji'i khar bzhag de'i shar du mchod yon dang zhabs bsil/ shar lhor zhal bsil/ lhor bsang gtor/ lho nub tu me tog nub tu spos dang mar me/ nub byang du dri chab/ byang du zhal zas/ byang shar du mtshams 'dzin/ mdun du dkar gtor zlum po gcig bcas bsham/ sgrub pa po rang nyid khrus bya/ gdong dri zhim pos byug kha dri zhim par bya/ gos dkar po dri ma med pa bgo zhing*/ stan dkar po gtsang ma la bde bar 'dug ste/ mchod pa rnams/ oṃ a mṛ te hūm̐ phaṭa kyis bsang*/ swa bhā was sbyang*/ stong pa'i ngang las oṃ las byung ba'i rin po che las grub pa'i snod yangs shing rgya che ba rnams kyi nang du/ oṃ 'od du zhu ba las byung ba'i lha rdzas las grub pa'i mchod yon/ zhabs bsil/ zhal bsil/ bsang gtor/ me tog bdug spos/ mar me/ dri chab/ zhal zas/ rol mo rnams dwangs shing thogs pa med pa nam mkha'i mtha' klas par gyur par bsam/ oṃ badz+ra ar+ghaṃ swā hā/ de bzhin du/ pā d+yaṃ/ āñca ma naṃ/ prok+ṣa ṇaṃ/ puṣ+pe nas/ shab+da swā hā'i bar brjod la chu bzhir mchod yon gyi phyag rgya dang*/ gzhan rnams la so so'i phyag rgya spyi ltar byas pa'i rjes su/ rdo rje bzung zhing dril bu rgyun chags su dkrol la/
