oṃ badz+ra dharmā ra ṇi ta sogs lan gsum gyi byin gyis brlab/ de nas bdag bskyed skyabs 'gro nas brtsams te/ bzlas pa'i mthar 'dod don gsol gdab kyi bar sgrub thabs bzhin nyams su blang ngo*// gnyis pa dngos gzhi la/ mdun gyi dkyil 'khor/ oṃ a mṛ te hūm̐ phaṭa kyis bsang*/ swa bhā was stong par sbyang*/ stong pa'i ngang las pad+ma dkar po 'dab ma stong dang ldan pa'i lte bar zla ba'i dkyil 'khor gyi steng du/ skad cig gis lha mo dbyangs can ma sku mdog dkar mo shel dkar po dri ma med pa ltar/ phyi bltas nang gsal ba/ nang bltas phyi gsal ba/ 'od zer dkar po 'phro ba dang bcas pa/ zhal gcig phyag gnyis pa/ phyag gnyis kyis bai ḍūr+ya'i pi waṃ rgyud stong dang ldan pa sgreng bas lha dang dri za dang*/ rig pa 'dzin pa la sogs pa skye 'phags thams cad kyi yid 'phrog par mdzad pa/ dbu skra 'jam zhing mnyen pa bung ba ltar gnag pa/ thor cog cung zad dang bcas pa me tog dkar po'i phreng bas bcings pa/ lhag ma rgyab tu 'phyang ba la rin po che sna tshogs pa'i rgyan gyis spras pa/ gser gyi rna cha la rin po che sna tshogs pa'i phra bkod pas mkhur tshos mdzes par brgyan pa/ dbu rgyan/ mgul rgyan/ snyan rgyan/ do shal/ phyag gdub/ zhabs gdub rnams rin po che sna tshogs pas khra chabs se/ khrol le/ sil khrol gyi sgra snyan par sgrogs pa/ gzhon nu ma lo bcu drug lon pa'i rnam pa can/ lang tsho dar la babs pa/ reg na bde ba skyed pa'i nu ma gnyis mkhrang zhing rgyas pa/ chags pa'i nyams dang ldan pas g.yon du 'gying zhing*/ spyan zur mig gis gzigs pa/ ka tsa li kā'i stod g.yogs dang*/ smad g.yogs me tog gi tshom bus spras pa/ pad+ma dkar po'i chun 'phyang gis mdzes par brgyan zhing*/ spyi gtsug tu zla ba'i dkyil 'khor dri ma med pas brgyan pa/ zhabs gnyis tsog pu'i tshul gyis bzhugs pa/ de'i thugs kar pad+ma dkar po 'dab ma brgyad pa dkar zhing 'jam pa ze'u 'bru dmar ser gyis bskor ba'i mtshams nas nyi ma stong dang mnyam pa'i 'od zer 'phro ba/

lte ba'i steng nas zla ba'i dkyil 'khor nya gang ba dri ma med pa'i dbus su/ thugs rnam par mi rtog pa'i ngo bo yi ge hrīṃḥdakar po ring cha zla tshes thig le dang bcas pa/ 'dab ma rnams la mdun nas brtsams te g.yas skor du/ a ā/ i ī/ u ū/ ṛ ṝ/ l̥ l̥̄/ e ai/ o au/ aṃ aḥste yig 'bru zung re gnas pa/ thams cad kyang shel dkar po dri ma med pa ltar dwangs shing gsal ba/ cung zad gdan la ma reg par 'dar zhing*/ 'khor lo yig 'bru dang bcas pa'i 'od zer gyi drwa bas khams gsum gyi mun pa ma lus pa bsal ba'i nus pa dang ldan par gyur/ ces ngag tu brjod cing gsol ba btab la/ de nas rang nyid lha mo dbyangs can mar gsal ba'i thugs ka'i hrīṃḥlas 'od zer dkar po sna bug g.yas nas rlung phyir rgyu ba dang mnyam du 'phros pas/ lho phyogs rgya mtsho'i 'gram nas lha mo dbyangs can ma la sangs rgyas dang byang chub sems dpa'i tshogs kyi bskor ba oṃ badz+ra sa mā dzaḥ zhes pas spyan drang*/ lha mo 'khor bcas mdun gyi nam mkhar bzhugs pa la/ oṃ swa ra swa sti sa pa ri wā ra ar+ghaṃ/ pā d+yaṃ/ añca ma naṃ/ prok+ṣa ṇaṃ/ puṣ+pe nas/ shab+da pra tīñca swā hā'i bar gyis mchod/ oṃ swa ra swa sti me hṛ da ya tiṣ+ṭha hrīṃḥ zhes pas gnyis su med par bstim/ oṃ swa ra swa sti tiṣ+ṭha hrīṃḥ a ā nas/ aṃ aḥ'i bar nyer gcig bzlas pas brtan par bsam/ de nas mchod pa rnams kha gsos la/ gong ltar byin gyis brlabs te/ mchod yon phal cher mchod yon bla bre dang*// mchod yon bkod pa'i 'od zer rab bkye zhing*// mchod yon sna tshogs kun tu bkram byas nas// ngag gi dbang phyug dbyangs can lha mor mchod// oṃ swa ra swa sti sa pa ri wā ra ar+ghaṃ pra tīts+tsha swā hā/ de bzhin tu/ mchod yon gyi gnas su/ zhabs bsil dang*/ zhal bsil dang*/ bsang gtor dang*/ me tog nas/ rol mo'i bar spyi ltar dang*/ sngags kyang ar+ghaṃ gyi gnas su/

pā d+yaṃ/ āñca ma naṃ/ prok+ṣa ṇaṃ/ puṣ+pe nas/ shab+da'i bar du 'don pa bsgyur la so so'i phyag rgya dang bcas pas mchod/ bsdu na sngags tsam gyis chog bstod pa ni/ bram ze phur bus mdzad pa sogs tshig don phun sum tshogs pas bstod/ de nas gsung gi rjes gnang dang 'dra ba'i dngos grub len cing bzlas pa bya ba ni/ rang nyid lha mo dbyangs can mar gsal ba'i thugs ka'i 'khor lo'i hrīṃḥlas hrīṃḥgi phreng ba mu tig bstar la brgyus pa ltar byung*/ lte ba nas 'thon/ mdun bskyed kyi lte bar zhugs/ thugs ka'i 'khor lo'i hrīṃḥdang dbyer med du 'dres/ de las mar me gcig las gnyis chad kyi tshul du hrīṃḥyig bsam gyis mi khyab pa byung ba zhal nas thon/ rang gi zhal du zhugs nas thugs ka'i hrīṃḥl thim zhing*/ de lta bu'i tshul gyis 'khor ba las 'od zer dkar po phyogs bcur 'phros pas 'jig rten gyi khams mu med pa na bzhugs pa'i sangs rgyas dang byang chub sems dpa' 'phags pa nyan thos dang*/ rang sangs rgyas/ grub pa thob pa'i dpa' bo dang rnal 'byor ma dang*/ paṇ+ḍi ta dang*/ rig pa 'dzin pa dang*/ smon lam la dbang ba'i drang srong rnams dang*/ rgyal po dang*/ blon po dang*/ gzhon nu ma la sogs pa dang*/ rin po che dang*/ sman dang*/ rtsi bcud la sogs pa thams cad kyi shes rab dang*/ spobs pa dang*/ gzungs dang*/ mkhyen pa dang*/ brtse ba dang*/ nus mthu dang*/ gzi brjid dang*/ tshe dang bsod nams la sogs pa'i yon tan gyi nus pa thams cad rdo khab len gyis lcags sdud pa bzhin bsdus te/ rang gi kha nas zhugs/ 'khor lo yig 'bru dang bcas pa la thim pas shes bya thams cad la thogs pa med pa'i blo gros rgyas shing*/ gzi brjid nus mthu phun sum tshogs pa dang ldan par gyur/ ces brjod cing bsams la/ de lta bu'i dmigs pa dang ma bral ba'i ngang nas hrīṃḥzhes pa ji tsam nus kyi bar bzlas la/ mthar hrīṃḥdabyangs yig dang bcas pa bdun nam nyer gcig bzla/

de nas phreng ba mgo bor bzhag la/ oṃ hrīṃḥwa ra wāk wā dī na maḥzhes pas brtan par bsam mo// gsum pa rjes ni/ mchod pa rnams kha gsos la byin gyis brlab/ oṃ swa ra swa sti sa pa ri wā ra re re'i mgor sbyar ba'i chu bzhi sngon 'gro'i nyer spyod dharmā ra ṇi ta dang bcas pas mchod/ rgyal ba kun gyi gsung rab rgya mtsho yi// rnam par 'phrul pa'i dpal las legs byung zhing*// sgrub pa po la blo gros mchog ster ba// lha mo dbyangs can ma la phyag 'tshal lo// zhes pas bstod/ bdag gi snying la 'bab par mdzad du gsol/ ma rig pa'i mun pa bsal du gsol/ ye shes kyi snang ba bskyed du gsol/ nyon mongs pa'i drwa ba gcad du gsol/ ma rig pa'i ling tog bsal du gsol/ bdag med rtogs pa'i shes rab khyad par can bskyed du gsol/ zhes pas 'dod pa'i don la gsol ba gdab/ rdo rje sems dpa'i yig brgya lan gsum gyis lhag chad kha bskang*/ ma 'byor pa dang sogs kyis nongs pa bzod par gsol/ grol nyin ma gtogs nyin snga ma rnams kyi thun thams cad la/ phyogs bcu na bzhugs pa'i sangs rgyas dang byang chub sems dpa' thams cad bdag la dgongs su gsol/ ji srid nam mkha'i mtha' dang mnyam pa'i sems can thams cad mi gnas pa'i mya ngan las 'das pa'i sa la ma bzhag gi bar du rgyal ba rnams mya ngan las mi 'da' bar brtan par bzhugs su gsol/ bye brag tu yang mdun gyi 'khor lo la bskyed cing spyan drangs pa'i 'phags ma ngag gi dbang phyug ma/ ji srid sgrub pa'i cho ga ma grol gyi bar du brtan par bzhugs su gsol/ brtan par bzhugs nas bdag dang sems can thams cad la bdag med rtogs pa'i shes rab phun sum tshogs pa stsal du gsol/ oṃ su pra tiṣ+ṭha badz+rā ya swā hā/ zhes brjod cing me tog gtor/ dge ba 'di yis myur du bdag /sgra dbyangs lha mo 'grub gyur nas// sogs kyis dge ba'i rtsa ba sangs rgyas kyi sar bsngo zhing smon lam rnam par dag pa'i rgyas gdab/

de lta bu'i rim pas thun bzhir bya zhing*/ thun thams cad la gtor ma phul 'grub na rab/ ma grub kyang snga thun gyi bzlas pa brtan byed dang bcas pa grub pa'i rjes su/ gtor ma bsang sbyang*/ stong pa'i ngang las oṃ las byung ba'i rin po che las grub pa'i snod yangs shing rgya che ba'i nang du/ gtor ma kha dog dri ro nus pa phun sum tshogs pa bdud rtsi'i rgya mtsho chen por gyur/ oṃ āḥhūm̐/ lan gsum gyis byin gyis brlab/ oṃ swa ra swa sti sa pa ri wā ra oṃ a kā ro lan gsum gyis phul/ mtshan sngags sngon du 'gro ba'i chu bzhi nyer spyod kyis mchod/ rgyal ba kun gyi gsung rab sogs kyis bstod/ lha mo dbyangs can mas bdag dang sems can thams cad la bdag med rtogs pa'i shes rab khyad par can skye bar byin gyis brlab tu gsol/ zhes pas 'dod don gsol gdab byas la rjes chog la 'jug de lta bu zhag gsum mam/ lnga'am bdun la sogs par 'bad pa chen po'i sgo nas nyams su blangs pas rtags khyad par can ci rigs par 'byung zhing byin rlabs brtan par 'gyur ro// rtags bzang ngan gang byung yang mi la mi bshad par gsang ba dang*/ ched du 'dzin pa mi byed par mi dmigs pa'i rgyas 'debs pa gal che/ grol ba'i nyin par/ thun mjug tu brtan bzhugs mi bya bar/ bdag gi snying la 'bab par mdzad du gsol/ zhes sogs kyi 'dod pa'i don la gsol ba rtse gcig tu btab pa'i rjes/ oṃ swa ra swa sti me tiṣ+ṭha ku ru hūm̐/ zhes brjod pas mdun gyi lha mo rang la thim pas rgyud byin gyis brlabs par bsams la dge ba bsngo zhing bkra shis kyis mtha' brgyan par bya'o// de dag gi skabs su gegs byung ba rnams bsal ba'i tshul ni/ lo chen bi dza yas mdzad pa'i sgrub skor tshigs bcad ma dang*/ kun mkhyen dri med 'od zer gyis mdzad pa'i sgrub skor 'od kyi drwa ba sogs las kha bskang ste shes par bya'o//

tsan+dan dkar po/ gla rtsi/ gur gum/ gi waṃ bzhi cha mnyam du sbyar ba'i bzhi mnyam gyi lde gu/ mngar gsum mar dang sbyar ba'i zas mchog gi ril bu grangs ldan/ bzhi mnyam dang mngar gsum gyis sbags pa'i ku sha/ nas gro 'bras sran ma til dkar nag sogs 'bru sna tshogs bsres pa dang*/ ba dmar ser gyi mar khu dang*/ shing thog sna tshogs rnams bzhag rang gi g.yon du bsnyen pa'i skabs bzhin mchod pa dang gtor ma bsham/ gzhan yang bsang chu dang*/ me lha'i mchod pa byed na de'i mchod rdzas dang*/ bsreg rdzas kyang tshogs par bya'o// gnyis pa ni/ skyabs 'gro nas brtsams te/ bdag bskyed bzlas pa'i mthar thug pa sngon du 'gro bas/ bsang chu a mṛ ta brgya'am nyer gcig gis bsngags/ rdzas rnams la gtor te bsang sbyang*/ stong pa'i ngang las rin po che las grub pa'i snod yangs shing rgya che ba rnams kyi nang du/ mchod rdzas dang bsreg rdzas lha mnyes pa dang so so'i las bsgrub pa'i nus pa dang ldan par bsams la/ ar+ghaṃ nas shab+da'i bar dang*/ oṃ āḥhūm̐ gi byin gyis brlab/ de nas thab bsangs sbyangs la/ stong pa'i ngang las bh+rūm̐ las byung ba'i thab khung gser btso ma ltar 'bar ba/ kha khyer mu ran dang bcas pa dwangs gsal thogs pa med pa'i nang lha rdzas kyi bud shing gis gang bar bsams nas/ dge 'dun gyi tshang mang ngam/ rgyal po'i pho brang gi mes/ oṃ ag+na ye dz+wa la ram̐/ zhes brjod cing spar/ der raṃ las drang srong me lha'i ngo bo me 'bar ba'i rnam pa can du gyur/ rang gi snying ga nas 'od zer 'phros pas me lha 'khor bcas oṃ badz+ra sa mā dzaḥs spyan

dbyu gu rtse gsum pa'i phyag rgya rna ba'i drung du g.yob cing*/ drang*/ dzaḥhūm̐ baṃ hoḥ 'bar ba'i rnam pa dang gnyis su med par gyur/ oṃ ag+na ye ā dī bya ā dī bya ā bi sha ā bi sha ha bya ka bya bah+nā ya swā hā/ zhes dang*/ oṃ ag+na ye swā hā/ lan bdun gyis mar blugs gzar bdun gyis dgang gzar bkang la phul/ slar yang bsreg rdzas thams cad gcig tu bsres la/ oṃ ag+na ye swā hā/ zhes lan nyer gcig tsam phul/ de nas me bsang sbyang*/ stong pa'i ngang las pad+ma dkar po 'dab ma stong dang ldan pa'i lte bar zla ba'i dkyil 'khor gyi steng du/ zhes pa nas/ oṃ swa ra swa sti me hṛ da ya tiṣ+ṭha hrīṃḥ zhes pas gnyis su med par bstim pa'i bar sgrub pa'i skabs bzhin byas la/ oṃ swa ra swa sti tiṣ+ṭha hrīṃḥ a ā nas/ aṃ aḥ'i bar bdun nam nyer gcig bzla/ mtshan sngags sngon 'gro'i chu bzhi nyer spyod rol mor bcas pas mchod/ rgyal ba kun gyi gsung rab sogs ci shes pas bstod/ de nas/ oṃ pri tī de wī hrīṃḥdī bya dhū pe hūm̐ me pradz+nyā war+dha mā nā ya oṃ/ zhes pas bdug spos dang*/ oṃ pri tī de wī hrīṃḥdī bya puṣ+pe hūm̐ me pradz+nyā war+dha mā nā ya oṃ/ zhes pas me tog dang*/ de bzhin du sngags thog mtha' 'dra ba las/ dī pe/ zhes pas ting lo dang*/ bi le bā ni/ zhes pas lde gu dang*/ nai wi d+yas zas mchog dang*/ ag+na yes mar khu dang*/ a pra ti ha tas ku sha dang*/ bī dza yes 'bru sna tshogs/ shrī phā la yes shing thog sna tshogs rnams phul/ grangs zas mchog la 'dzin cing thun rer stong rtsa sogs 'bul lo// slar sgrub pa'i skabs nas bshad pa ltar gyis gtor ma phul la/ oṃ āḥswa ra swa sti me tiṣ+ṭha ku ru hūm̐/ zhes brjod de rang la thim par bsam/ sol ba chus bran te/ dam tshig pa'i 'khor lo bsdu ba'i phyir/ sol ba'i phyogs gcig nas sna bug tu rngubs te bris pa'i 'khor lo 'jug pa'i rlung dang lhan cig tu snying gar thim par bsam mo// gsum pa ni/

slar yang me lha la mar khu dang bsreg rdzas lhag ma rnams ag+na'i sngags kyis phul/ ag+na ye gats+tsha/ zhes dbyu gu'i phyag rgya phyir bstan nas gshegs su gsol/ smon lam dang bkra shis bya'o// de ni rgyas pa'i tshul lo// de las mchod pa'i skabs rnams bor bas 'bring po'o// kha khyer mu ran stegs bu rnams mi 'bri ba dang*/ bsreg rdzas rnams/ hrīṃḥme pradz+nyā war+dha mā nā ya oṃ/ zhes pa kho nas 'bul ba ni bsdus pa dang*/ shin tu bsdus pa ni/ hrīṃḥzhes pa kho nas bsreg rdzas rnams 'bul/ gzhan sngar ltar ro// tshul 'di ni bsnyen sgrub las sbyor mtha' dag la mkho che zhing*/ sdig sgrib zhi ba dang*/ sgrub pa'i bogs dngos su 'byin cing*/ bar chad thams cad zhi ba/ tshogs rdzogs pa sogs lha dgyes pa'i thabs bla na med pa yin te/ sgrub skor tshigs bcad ma las/ rang dang gzhan gyi don gyi phyir// sbyin sreg byas na lkugs pa yang*// snyan dngags mkhan du 'gyur bar gsungs// zhes pa ltar ro// de dag gi skabs su spang blang ji ltar bya ba'i tshul ni/ sha chang sgog btsong la sogs pa kha zas mi gtsang ba'i rigs spangs nas/ rtag tu khrus dang gtsang sbra la gnas pa dang*/ khyad par du ngag gi dam tshig rdzun mi smra ba dang*/ rang nyid shes rab che bar rloms pa'i nga rgyal dang gzhan la 'gran par 'dod pa'i phrag dog la sogs pa rgyang ring du dor nas/ bla ma dang dkon mchog sogs mchod par 'os pa rnams la mi smad/ bsnyen pa sogs song nas kyang rtag par 'phags ma'i bsnyen sgrub kyi dam bca' sngags brgya rtsa re ma chag par nyin re bzhin bzla bar bya'o// de ltar byas pas mtshungs pa med pa'i snyan ngag dang*/ 'chad pa dang*/ 'dzin pa la sogs pa gang 'dod pa'i shes rab nam mkha' ltar rgya che zhing*/ mi ring bar ji lta ba dang*/ ji snyed pa mkhyen pa'i shes rab nyi zla ltar gsal bas lha dang bcas pa'i 'jig rten thams cad na snyan pa'i grags pas khyab par 'gyur pa ni nges pa'o//
